Option to voluntarily add additional financial protection in the event of an unfortunate loss.

About Us
Unity. Loyalty. Advancement. Charity. It’s what drives United Legwear & Apparel Co. to be the best global designer, manufacturer, and distributor of legwear, bodywear, apparel, and accessories. Founded in 1998 by Isaac E. Ash to make the very best legwear on the market, ULAC is an industry leader offering a full range of products for babies, kids, teens, and adults. We strive to sell our products at affordable prices for families. Hard work and exponential growth year on year has transformed ULAC into a global apparel and accessories company.Our goal to deliver superior products that ensure superior customer satisfaction is made possible by our team of dedicated professionals who work together to make the company the best in business. Our manufacturing, distribution, and logistics division produces the highest quality products at the best possible prices without cutting corners. Integrity of goods is key, so compliance and quality assurance are top priorities, along with meeting every delivery date—whether shipping across the state or around the world. We strive to foster an inclusive company culture that stands united to accomplish our mission. We are loyal to our people, supporting their development and ability to achieve excellence. We believe that when people bring their personal best to work each day, it leads to success, advancement, and upward mobility for all. We believe every individual has two hands: one to help themself, and one to help others. We pride ourselves in our value of charity and the commitments we make to help people in need. ULAC supports organizations that help those compromised by sickness, poverty, natural disasters, socioeconomic inequality, and other dire circumstances. If you share our vision of delivering superior products in a culture of growth, excellence, and caring, then we want to hear from you!For more information about United Legwear & Apparel Co., please visit: https://ulac.com/

Our Leadership Team Responsibilities
At ULAC, we are looking for people who share our vision of fostering a collaborative culture of continuous improvement. All team members at ULAC are responsible for contributing to a safe and positive work environment so everyone can deliver their best. Leadership behaviors that model ULAC’s mission and values of Unity, Loyalty, Achievement, and Charity include:

Lead Proactively: Anticipate and solve problems early, stay curious, and encourage team members to focus on solutions and high performance. Drive innovation by identifying and implementing improved approaches.Provide Positive & Frequent Performance Feedback: Regularly recognize good work, pinpoint improvement areas, and help with ongoing development.Initiate Structure: Implement clear, challenging team goals, communicate them effectively, and create organized plans that align with company objectives.Achieve Objectives: Create and follow through on effective plans, guide team members consistently, and use data from reports to make decisions that help people and processes.Foster Positive Culture: Build and maintain an uplifting, trusting, and innovative workplace.Communicate Effectively: Promote open communication, listen actively, and facilitate teamwork and conflict resolution.Motivate and Inspire: Lead by example, show respect, and give encouragement. Inspire teams to achieve their best.Train and Develop Others: Act as a coach and mentor, focus on transferring knowledge, enhancing skills, and supporting high performance.

Physical Demands And Working Conditions
The physical demands and working conditions of this position are representative of what must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The functions of this position are typically performed in an office setting and the noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to walk. The employee may be occasionally required to stand and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision and distance vision.

rows.title: Development Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

The DreamYard Vision: 

Building Artists- Building Community- Building Dreams- To change the world.

DreamYard Mission And History

DreamYard (DY), founded in 1994, is a Bronx-based organization that uses the arts, social justice pedagogy, and digital and connected learning to inspire youth, public schools, and communities. DreamYard’s yearlong arts programs develop artistic voices, nurture young people's desire to make change, and cultivate the skills necessary to reach positive goals. By committing to sustained learning opportunities along an educational pathway, with 45 partnering public schools K-12th Grade, with our own DY Prep HS School and at the DreamYard Art Center in Morrisania, DreamYard supports young people as they work toward higher learning, meaningful careers, and social action. We seek to be effective locally while having a national and international impact through partnerships, collaboration, and learning exchanges.

Anti-racism Commitment

At DreamYard, we commit to being an anti-racist organization. We lead with race because we operate in a country founded on the genocide of Indigenous people, the enslavement of African people, and the oppression of countless others. We acknowledge the role this history plays in perpetuating inequity and dominant white culture.

The Community 

DreamYard is focused on the Bronx, a borough that possesses incredible cultural, human and economic assets. In addition to working throughout the Bronx, DreamYard partners with local, national and international communities to utilize the arts to build bridges to opportunity. The organization believes that the arts are a necessary part of developing our local assets to their greatest potential.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director of Development, the Development Coordinator supports all of DreamYard’s fundraising activities, with a particular focus on development operations, individual giving and stewardship, grants administration, and events.

The Development Coordinator works extensively within DreamYard’s CRM (Little Green Light) to ensure Development data is accurate, complete, and useful; processes and acknowledges gifts; tracks donor and prospect engagement; coordinates grant deadlines, supporting documentation, and reporting requirements; supports individual giving campaigns and donor cultivation; and produces reports and analysis that inform fundraising strategy.

This position is well suited to an organized, detail-oriented development professional who enjoys working with data and systems as much as working with people. The successful candidate will be comfortable managing recurring processes independently, identifying gaps or inconsistencies, and helping develop more effective systems as DreamYard expands its fundraising program.

This is a hybrid role. Minimum in-person requirement is one day a week every other week, with additional in-person attendance required for staff workshops, special events, and program visits.

Key Responsibilities

Development Operations, CRM & Data

Maintain accurate and complete donor, prospect, institutional, event, gift, and engagement records in Little Green Light.Process gifts and maintain complete and accurate contribution records, including appropriate documentation, coding, and donor information.Conduct regular database audits and resolve duplicate, incomplete, or inconsistent records.Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve Development tracking and workflows.

Individual Giving & Donor Stewardship

Prepare timely donor acknowledgements, tax receipts, and other stewardship correspondence.Maintain donor stewardship and cultivation plans and track correspondence, meetings, solicitations, and other touchpoints in Little Green Light.Support annual and special giving campaigns, including list preparation, segmentation, mailings, digital appeals, and response tracking.Conduct donor and prospect research and assist with identifying prospective individual, corporate, and institutional supporters.Prepare agendas, donor histories, prospect profiles, briefing materials, and other information for meetings and solicitations.Support donor cultivation and stewardship activities, including communications, visits, small gatherings, and special events.

Grants & Institutional Giving

Maintain grant records, agreements, budgets, reporting requirements, and supporting documentation.Track grant deliverables and reporting requirements and proactively flag upcoming deadlines or information needs.Coordinate with Program, Finance, and other staff to gather information needed for proposals and reports.Assist with proposal and report preparation, submission, and funder research.Maintain current organizational documents and standard application materials required for funding applications.

Development Events

Support Development-related cultivation, stewardship, and fundraising events, including the annual gala.Manage Development event data, guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, donor information, sponsorship records, and post-event follow-up.

Finance & Reporting

Work closely with the Director of Development and Finance team to reconcile contributed revenue and ensure consistency between Little Green Light and financial records.Assist with tracking restricted grants, pledges, payments, and other contributed revenue.Maintain documentation needed for audits and financial reporting related to contributed revenue.Other duties as assigned by management.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 1 year of experience in nonprofit administration, development, fundraising operations, grants management, database administration, or a related field.Experience with a CRM required (Salesforce, Tessitura, Little Green Light, Raiser’s Edge, etc.)Must know how to exercise discretion and discernment with regards to highly confidential information.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping and data integrity.Proficiency with Google suite

Compensation

The Development Coordinator is a full-time, non-exempt position with a salary range of $55,000-$60,000 based on experience.

To Apply

Please use the link below to submit a resume and cover letter.

DreamYard is an Equal Opportunity Employer is an equal opportunity employer. DreamYard prohibits unlawful discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, age, national origin, genetic characteristics, disability, status as a special disabled veteran or veteran, marital status, sexual orientation, sexual identity or any other basis prohibited by law.

DreamYars is also committed to the principles of arts education, educational reform, and social justice, and fashions its programs to specifically address the needs of urban communities that are typically underrepresented because of race, sex, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status. Accordingly, we welcome and encourage applications from a diverse range of individuals. Bronx-based and Spanish-speaking applicants are strongly encouraged to apply.

COVID19 Protocol

Please note that proof of vaccinations will be required as a DreamYard COVID-19 health and safety protocol.

Disclaimer

Job duties and requirements are ever-changing based on the demands of the client, industry, and company. This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities, but is an overall picture of job requirements, that is subject to modification at the company’s discretion.

In U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), our product is Membership—delivering benefits and services that are essential to our Card Members across travel, dining, entertainment, and retail. We compete by providing a differentiated Membership experience that drives loyalty and long-term growth. USCS brings this to life through our premium, cobrand, cash back, and lending portfolios, Membership Rewards, Travel & Lifestyle Services, the Centurion Lounge network, Global Dining, U.S. Consumer Banking, Amex Offers, Amex Ads, and best-in-class marketing programs.

The team drives the portfolio vision, value proposition design, financial performance, and innovation—ensuring we deliver differentiated, customer-centric products that drive acquisition, increase engagement, and create mutual value for both organizations.

This Senior Analyst will be responsible for driving high-priority portfolio operations and partner-facing workstreams that will enable growth for the Delta Cobrand portfolio. This is a highly visible role, with responsibilities spanning across the end-to-end product management lifecycle, inclusive of program reporting, competitive insights, benefit management, invoicing, and operational risk management.

This individual will partner closely with Finance, Analytics, Control Management and Compliance teams, while supporting ongoing engagement with Delta counterparts.

This impactful role is for someone who wants to gain experience in product management and exposure to the P/L. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, comfortable operating across ambiguity, and energized by working at the intersection of product strategy, partner management, and execution. A successful candidate is someone who can connect day-to-day operational details to broader portfolio priorities, helping the team identify opportunities to improve customer experience, strengthen controls, and unlock growth.

Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Analytics, Control Management, Compliance, and Delta partners to move initiatives forward Responsible for day-to-day key partner and product operations, including but not limited to reporting, invoicing, and insightsDeliver and synthesize insights and analyses through competitive research and trends to inform product improvements and leadership decision makingContribute innovative ideas that elevate and influence the broader portfolio and strategySupport benefit management across the product lifecycle, including monitoring performance, coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues, and ensuring benefit delivery is compliant and aligned to the intended customer experienceMonitor Operational Risk Events and Issues Management through escalations, identifying root causes, and drive remediation efforts for risk mitigation Serve as control management lead by creating and performing control testing, smart monitoring, and mitigating customer or operational issues

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

David Yurman is a celebrated American jewelry company founded in New York by David Yurman, a sculptor, and his wife, Sybil, a painter and ceramicist. When the artists began collaborating, their goal was simply to make beautiful objects to wear. Led today by their son Evan, David Yurman creates timeless, yet contemporary collections for women and men defined by inspiration, innovation, consummate craftsmanship and cable – the brand’s artistic signature. David Yurman collections are available at retail stores throughout the United States, Canada, Hong Kong and France and at locations worldwide, through their exclusive authorized fine jewelry and timepiece network of retailers.

Our Values

At David Yurman, creativity, innovation and impeccable craftsmanship are at the core of everything we do. Fueled by the energy of our hometown, New York City, artistic passion informs each and every jewelry design. The Yurman family’s guiding vision continually defines and redefines what it means to be the preeminent American luxury jewelry brand. We are committed to responsible business and social practices and to the protection and advancement of human rights. We believe in partnering with others who share these values and understand their importance.

Overview

Job Description

The Product Costing & Analytics Analyst supports accurate, timely, and data-driven product costing across the development and production lifecycle. This role is responsible for validating cost components, analyzing pricing and margin variances, maintaining costing data within key systems, and partnering with cross-functional teams and vendors to ensure product costs are complete, consistent, and aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with complex data, cost sheets, BOMs, purchase orders, invoices, and reporting tools.

Responsibilities

Review, validate, and analyze product costing information, including cost sheets, BOMs, purchase orders, invoices, and supporting documentation, to ensure accuracy and completeness. Evaluate daily purchase order price change requests, investigate discrepancies, and partner with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve pricing or documentation issues. Perform variance analysis between show costing, development costing, final production costing, and post-production updates to support margin visibility and profitability maintenance. Maintain and update costing data, cost charts, and related reporting to support accurate business analysis and decision-making. Use Excel, Sigma, PLM, Qiwk reports, Jira, and other systems to maintain accurate data, generate reporting, and identify inconsistencies in costing information. Develop a strong understanding of DY jewelry components, materials, labor, finishing instructions, and product construction to accurately evaluate cost structures. Conduct thorough self-review of calculations, pricing inputs, and supporting details prior to submission to ensure high data integrity. Communicate costing updates, discrepancies, and required actions clearly to cross-functional partners, including Product Development, Procurement, Merchandising, Production, and vendors. Continuously prioritize competing tasks, monitor deadlines, and adjust focus as business needs evolve while maintaining accuracy and responsiveness. 

Qualifications

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to review high-volume costing, pricing, BOM, PO, and invoice data for accuracy, gaps, and inconsistencies. Advanced Excel skills, including large datasets, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and analytical reporting. Proactive problem solver with sound judgment and the ability to validate information, question unusual cost changes, resolve discrepancies, and improve data accuracy. Proven ability to work proactively and independently while contributing as a collaborative team partnerHighly organized communicator able to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, summarize findings, and follow up effectively with internal teams and vendors. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with effective interpersonal skills. Experience with PLM, Sigma, Qiwk, Jira, or similar product lifecycle/reporting systems preferred; knowledge of jewelry materials, components, production processes, or product costing a plus. 

Education: Bachelor’s Degree

Location: New York, NY

Working Mode: Hybrid

Estimate Salary Range:  $85k – 98k

Base pay is one component of David Yurman’s total compensation package, which may also include the following for eligible employees: access to healthcare benefits, 401(k) plan, bonus, employee discounts, Summer Fridays (corporate roles), generous paid time off, sick time, and more.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at David Yurman

As a company founded by artists, David Yurman champions self-expression in everything we do. We are committed to fostering a culture of openness and creative collaboration within our entire community, and we cherish the diversity of our employees’ backgrounds and perspectives. We will always advocate for equity and inclusion for all.

David Yurman is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to an individual’s age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender).

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the operational engine behind our Global Banking & Markets FICC & Equities marketing team. Global Banking & Markets 

Global Banking & Markets comprises our two market-leading franchises, Investment Banking and FICC and Equities.

Our Investment Banking business is built on a culture of enduring partnerships and a commitment to delivering exceptional execution, idea generation and client service. We have earned our position as the leader in global M&A and Financing by consistently mobilizing the power of Goldman Sachs in service of our clients, successfully executing the world’s most complex and consequential transactions. We work with corporations, pension funds, financial sponsors, sovereign wealth funds and governments. The expertise and judgment of our team, backed by an unparalleled global network of relationships, allows us to unlock opportunities for growth and transformation to deliver superior outcomes for the clients we serve.

Our FICC and Equities business brings the comprehensive reach and diverse capabilities of a global firm to bear for the world’s leading asset managers, hedge funds, banks and brokerages, pensions, endowments and foundations, and corporations and governments. Operating at the center of global financial markets, we combine out-of-consensus market insights, relentless proactivity, and a commitment to deliver unmatched execution with superior products and solutions built to drive performance and withstand volatility.

Led by the firm’s first Chief Marketing Officer, the marketing function at Goldman Sachs comprises a global team of growth marketers, delivering value for the brand and the business. The organization consists of a number of COE functions in areas such as Brand, Media, and Marketing Strategy, as well as marketing leads for each of our revenue divisions. Together, this team collaborates to bring a unified, scalable, and consistent approach to marketing the brand and our business offerings. Our mission is to be a demonstrable force multiplier for the businesses we serve.

Within Global Marketing sits the Global Banking & Markets marketing team, responsible for end-to-end marketing strategies and programs for the entirety of the division. Within FICC & Equities, the team works across the firm’s businesses, leading integrated marketing strategies across messaging, brand, content, social, paid media, client engagement, digital marketing, and marketing analytics.

The Marketing Operations Specialist drives the operational efficiency, project management, and logistical coordination of our marketing initiatives. Serving as a key cross-functional collaborator, you will oversee the critical day-to-day business functions that keep our programs running smoothly including budget tracking, procurement administration, contract management, and event logistics support. Beyond executing daily operations, you will proactively identify process bottlenecks, design smarter workflows, and build the infrastructure needed to scale our efforts.  Track project timelines, status and deliverable calendars across concurrent programs, proactively flagging risks, dependencies, and approval bottlenecks to keep work on schedule. Streamline and optimize processes and workflows, documenting them as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and templates and training the team on their use.

 2–4 years of experience in marketing operations or project management, ideally supporting multiple business lines in a matrixed environment.  Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams against competing deadlines, with exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.  Proficiency with work management and tracking tools such as Monday.com, Smartsheet or equivalents, and Excel. GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS

Global Banking & Markets provides financing, advisory services, risk distribution and hedging for our institutional and corporate clients through our FICC and Equities (“GBM Public”) and Investment Banking (“GBM Private”) franchises.

SUPERVISORY RISK & CONTROLS 

The Supervisory Risk & Controls team within Global Banking & Markets (GBM) manages controls covering supervisory-related risks arising from business activities in the Global Banking & Markets (GBM) division. The team partners with businesses to implement controls, support ongoing monitoring and oversight, as well as related supervisory tools to manage risk.

We are looking for an individual to support the expansion of the program to cover business activities in GBM Private, focusing on the Capital Solutions Group (CSG).

Our Capital Solutions Group is a comprehensive suite of our financing, origination, structuring, and risk management solutions. The depth and breadth of our relationships, enriched by the velocity of our deal flow, provide clients unique insights to maximize value and unlock opportunity. Our integrated structure is built to provide comprehensive, tailored solutions that propel both our issuing and investing clients forward.

 Develop understanding of Capital Solutions Group (CSG) business activities  Support the development of the supervisory framework for CSG business activities, including appropriate desk controls, monitoring & tools  Define and implement appropriate controls to manage risk, including supervisor expectations and escalation  Support governance processes to drive monitoring & oversight for the covered controls  Build relationships with relevant stakeholder groups to implement the program, including bankers, Compliance, Engineering, Legal and others, as relevant  Engage with GBM Public side teams to drive consistency across the divisional supervisory program and related monitoring

 Bachelor’s degree.  2-3 years of relevant work experience  Prior knowledge of banking activities including financing, origination, structuring & underwriting preferred.  Familiarity with securities markets, derivative products, deal flows.  Strong time and project management/organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to handle a fast-paced environment; communicate factually and influentially.

People who are rooted in the legacy that makes Gap what it is, but who are also focused on the future. People who want to leave the world better than they found it.

We’ve built our brand on staying true to our roots while always being out in front of what’s next. If you want to be part of an iconic American brand, and help lead the way for where we’re headed, we’d love to have you join us.

About The Role

Gap Inc. is transforming how its brands use data and AI to make faster, more precise commercial decisions, and the Senior Analyst, Pricing Optimization is where that analytical work gets executed. This role is the analytical foundation of Gap Inc.’s pricing function—the person who runs the day-to-day models, prepares the data, validates outputs from pricing agents, and ensures the team has accurate, well-structured analysis ready to inform every pricing and promotional decision. Reporting to the Manager, Pricing Optimization, you will support the execution of specific pricing and promotional analytics work streams—preparing data, running models, and applying rigorous quality checks to outputs from pricing agents. You will produce clean, accurate analysis that your manager and team bring to business owners and finance partners. This is an individual contributor role designed for someone who is analytically precise, eager to build their skills in an AI-enabled pricing environment, and ready to be a foundational contributor to a function being built from scratch.

What you'll do

Execute Pricing Analytics and Data Preparation

Prepare and maintain pricing and promotional data for assigned work streams—pulling, cleaning, and organizing retail data sets so they are accurate, complete, and ready for analysis and modeling.Run pricing models and scenario analyses under the direction of the Manager—applying elasticity inputs, sensitivity parameters, and promotional variables to generate outputs that are accurate, well-structured, and ready for review.Apply and quality-check outputs from pricing agents across assigned categories—validating data inputs, flagging anomalies or inconsistencies, and ensuring outputs are accurate before they move forward in the analytical workflow.Support in-season monitoring of pricing actions for assigned work streams—tracking performance against plan, flagging variances, and surfacing data that helps the team identify risks or optimization opportunities quickly.Use AI reporting tools and pricing platforms as a daily analytical tool—interrogating outputs with a critical eye, maintaining data integrity, and escalating to the Manager when outputs require additional human review before informing a decision.

Support Analysis and Reporting

Assemble analytical work into clean, well-organized supporting materials—building the data packages, tables, and summaries that your manager brings to business reviews and stakeholder discussions.Prepare data pulls, performance summaries, and analytical inputs for weekly and monthly business reviews—ensuring pricing performance across assigned categories is accurately captured and clearly organized for the team to build on.Develop your ability to translate analytical outputs into plain commercial framing—connecting what the data shows to what it means for margin, revenue, or promotional performance, and communicating that clearly in your deliverables.Respond to analytical requests from the pricing team with accuracy and care, building a track record as someone who can be counted on to deliver clean, well-organized work on time.

Contribute to Building the Pricing Function

Contribute to the ongoing training and refinement of pricing agents—documenting instances where outputs fall short, noting patterns in errors or gaps, and sharing observations with the team to improve model performance over time.Help build shared documentation and analytical standards for the team—capturing what good looks like in data preparation, output validation, and model quality review so that practices are consistent and repeatable as the function grows.Bring a curious, builder’s mindset to a function that is being created from scratch—asking questions, trying new approaches, and actively contributing ideas about how this team’s analytical processes can work better as it scales.

Who you are

Experience

Bachelor’s degree required1-4 years of experience in pricing analytics, demand planning, merchandise planning, commercial analytics, or a related field—including internship or co-op experience in retail or consumer products.Foundational analytical skills and a strong desire to build proficiency in pricing model execution: data preparation, elasticity inputs, sensitivity analysis, promotional effectiveness, and scenario modeling.Experience or an aptitude for working with AI-generated analytical outputs: you are comfortable applying, reviewing, and quality-checking outputs from pricing agents, and you understand the importance of human oversight before outputs inform decisions.Comfort with reporting and analytics platforms; you learn tools quickly, apply them in your day-to-day analytical work, and are motivated to build fluency as new tools are introduced.Demonstrated ability to produce clean, well-organized analytical work—data that is accurate, clearly structured, and ready for a manager or team to build on and act from.

Leadership & Mindset

Analytically precise: you hold a high personal bar for data accuracy, take ownership of the work you produce, and don’t let outputs move forward until you’re confident they’re right.Commercially curious: you want to understand why the numbers matter, not just how to produce them—and you actively connect your analytical work to business outcomes like margin, revenue, and promotional performance.Clear and organized communicator: you present data and analysis in a way that is easy to follow—well-labeled, logically structured, and free of ambiguity about what you’re showing and what it means.AI-partnership mindset: you engage with pricing agents and agentic tools with genuine curiosity and appropriate rigor—applying outputs carefully, asking questions when something doesn’t look right, and grounding your work in ethical and brand-aligned judgment.Eager to grow: you bring genuine interest in how pricing, AI, and retail intersect, actively seek to build your skills as the tools and function evolve, and approach your work with a test-and-learn mindset.Customer-minded optimizer: You recognize that successful pricing strategies balance commercial outcomes with the customer experience. You thoughtfully incorporate the unique needs of store and online customers into your analyses, helping ensure pricing actions drive business results while preserving clarity, consistency, and trust in the brand experience who builds trust, operates with urgency, and improves the capability over time.

Salary Range: $93,700.00 - $121,800.00

Global Banking & Markets provides financing, advisory services, risk distribution and hedging for our institutional and corporate clients through our FICC and Equities (“GBM Public”) and Investment Banking (“GBM Private”) franchises.

The Supervisory Risk & Controls team within Global Banking & Markets (GBM) manages controls covering supervisory-related risks arising from business activities in the Global Banking & Markets (GBM) division. The team partners with businesses to implement controls, support ongoing monitoring and oversight, as well as related supervisory tools to manage risk.

We are looking for an individual to support the expansion of the program to cover business activities in GBM Private, focusing on the Capital Solutions Group (CSG).

The Data Scientist, Generosity Experimentation will play a pivotal role in growing an experimentation function within the Sportsbook Commercial team focused on retention and loyalty. In addition, the Data Scientist will have the opportunity to be involved in key strategic initiatives that support FanDuel’s overall growth.

Everyone on our team has a part to play

Compile results and present insights and recommendations to marketing leadership. Continue the advancement of a cross-functional experimentation program. Be a thought leader in identifying and evaluating tools and capabilities to advance our practice, including opportunities for automation. Introduce advanced statistical techniques to support data analysis and insight generation. Drive culture of experimentation throughout the Sportsbook business through initiatives to educate organization on experimentation best practices.

What we're looking for in our next teammate

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the Role?

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join Etsy’s Payments Analytics team and help make payments more seamless and reliable. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and fellow analysts to evaluate opportunities and inform product decisions through analysis, experimentation, and foundational data work.

This is a full-time position reporting to the Manager, Analytics.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

The Payments team improves buyer and seller financial experiences and the infrastructure that supports transactions across Etsy. Payments Analytics helps the team understand customer behavior, builds trusted data sources, and measures the impact of product decisions.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Own well-scoped analyses, from understanding product goals and questions to defining metrics that measure success and sharing findings.Analyze buyer and seller behaviors to identify ways to improve payments experiences.Design and analyze experiments to measure product impact.Build and maintain reliable datasets and dashboards, with clear documentation.Turn findings into actionable recommendations and work with partner teams to prioritize follow-up opportunities.Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

2+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or another quantitative role, using data to answer business questions.Proficient in SQL, with some experience in Python or R.Experience with experimentation, dashboarding, and foundational statistical methods.Ability to manage well-scoped analytical projects and collaborate with stakeholders from planning through delivery.Strong commitment to data quality, reproducibility, and clear documentationAbility to communicate insights clearly and translate findings into actionable recommendationsCuriosity about customer behavior and a growth mindset.Experience in payments, marketplaces, or e-commerce is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

 Geo-1: 126,000.00 - 170,000.00 USD Annual Geo-2: 113,000.00 - 153,000.00 USD Annual

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. Position Summary: The Office of Student Enrollment (OSE) manages admissions, enrollment, and transfers for students in New York City Public Schools (NYCPS) Early Childhood programs, 2-K through grade 12, including District 75 schools. Additionally, the office oversees 12+ sites consisting of Family Welcome Centers (FWCs), Family Resource Centers (FRCs), and a call center, which are family facing offices that conduct enrollment transactions and provide community based support to families. OSE designs and implements enrollment and admissions policies and processes that provide all students with access to high quality public schools. OSE also has teams dedicated to supporting our most vulnerable students, including students with disabilities, students in temporary housing, foster care, and other special populations.

The Enrollment Research, Analytics, and Policy (ERAP) team manages research and analysis for all admissions processes and other enrollment related processes, and collaborates across the NYCPS to provide data and research support for 2-K through grade 12.

The ERAP 2-K Analyst manages all aspects of research and analytics related to the admissions processes administered by the Office of Student Enrollment (OSE), including 2-K, 3-K, pre kindergarten, kindergarten, gifted and talented programs, middle school, high school, and specialized high school admissions. The Analyst independently leads and executes complex research and analytic work that supports continuous improvement of centrally managed and field based enrollment operations, informs policy decisions, and contributes to internal and external publications and communications. Performs related work.

Reports to: Senior Director, Enrollment Research, Analytics and Policy

Direct Reports: N/A

Key Relationships: Office of Student Enrollment (OSE) senior leadership, including the other Senior Directors and Executive Directors; Division of Early Childhood Education and Division of Instructional and Information Technology.

Responsibilities

Admissions Process Management

Manage all operational analytical aspects of the admissions process including application tracking, data collection and management, data cleaning, developing seat and match targets (the number of students that may receive an offer to a school or program) and reporting to schools and other stakeholders, and list noticing students to school registers.Independently design, manage, and execute complex and strategic research and analytic work that informs admissions policy, operational decision making, and continuous improvement of enrollment systems, while coordinating closely with senior leadership, technical teams, and external stakeholders.Develop deep content and systems expertise with MySchools; partner with engineering and product teams to translate admissions policy and operational requirements into technical specifications, identify systemic risks, and guide testing and release readiness across admissions cycles.Report on registers, applicants, seats, demographics, and other admissions and enrollment related areas. Synthesize analytical findings into clear recommendations for OSE senior leadership to support policy and operational decisions. rows.title: Data Scientist, Payments
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What’s the Role?

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join Etsy’s Payments Analytics team and help make payments more seamless and reliable. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and fellow analysts to evaluate opportunities and inform product decisions through analysis, experimentation, and foundational data work.

This is a full-time position reporting to the Manager, Analytics.

What’s this team like at Etsy?

The Payments team improves buyer and seller financial experiences and the infrastructure that supports transactions across Etsy. Payments Analytics helps the team understand customer behavior, builds trusted data sources, and measures the impact of product decisions.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Own well-scoped analyses, from understanding product goals and questions to defining metrics that measure success and sharing findings.Analyze buyer and seller behaviors to identify ways to improve payments experiences.Design and analyze experiments to measure product impact.Build and maintain reliable datasets and dashboards, with clear documentation.Turn findings into actionable recommendations and work with partner teams to prioritize follow-up opportunities.Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities that will help you thrive in this role are:

2+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or another quantitative role, using data to answer business questions.Proficient in SQL, with some experience in Python or R.Experience with experimentation, dashboarding, and foundational statistical methods.Ability to manage well-scoped analytical projects and collaborate with stakeholders from planning through delivery.Strong commitment to data quality, reproducibility, and clear documentationAbility to communicate insights clearly and translate findings into actionable recommendationsCuriosity about customer behavior and a growth mindset.Experience in payments, marketplaces, or e-commerce is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

 Geo-1: 126,000.00 - 170,000.00 USD Annual Geo-2: 113,000.00 - 153,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. While Etsy supports visa sponsorship, sponsorship opportunities may be limited to certain roles and skills.

rows.title: Analyst, Energy & Sustainability

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Role Summary

Vornado's Sustainability group is seeking a full-time Analyst to work in the New York office. The Analyst will support the Vice President, Engineering with utility and emissions data analysis across the portfolio, and will be the Company's source of record for energy consumption and greenhouse gas data.

Every energy and emissions figure Vornado reports — to investors, to regulators, to rating agencies, and to the U.S. EPA — originates with this position. The Analyst is responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of that data, and for preparing it into the submissions and applications the Company files each year. The Analyst also serves as Vornado's primary point of contact with the EPA's ENERGY STAR program.

As a fully integrated REIT, sustainability at Vornado reaches across all divisions, including development, operations, leasing, capital markets, acquisitions, accounting and finance, legal, marketing, and risk management. The Analyst will work regularly with Property Management, building engineering teams, Accounting, and outside consultants, and will handle utility data requests from across the Company.

The successful candidate is rigorous with data, comfortable working from incomplete or inconsistent source records, and able to explain analytical results clearly to colleagues who are not analysts. This is a strong role for someone who wants deep, defensible expertise in commercial real estate energy and carbon accounting.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Portfolio Utility Data Analysis

Maintain the portfolio-wide utility dataset across all fuels and commodities — electricity, district steam, natural gas, fuel oil, and water — for landlord-controlled, whole-building, and tenant-metered accounts.Account for consumption at the meter and account level; identify and resolve data gaps, estimated reads, duplicate accounts, rate class changes, and meter reconfigurations.Track portfolio and building-level performance against the Company's reduction targets, including occupancy adjustment and weather normalization on a heating and cooling degree day basis.Reconcile utility billing records against ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager and internal Company systems; investigate and document all variances.Build and maintain the analytical workbooks and recurring reporting the Vice President, Engineering and the Chief Sustainability Officer rely on.Support the Vice President, Engineering on measurement and verification of capital projects by preparing normalized baseline and post-period consumption data. The Vice President owns the verification approach and the determination of project performance.Respond to utility data requests from Property Management, Accounting, Leasing, Legal, Development, and Investor Relations.

Greenhouse Gas Emissions Accounting

Maintain the Company's greenhouse gas inventory in accordance with the GHG Protocol, covering Scope 1, Scope 2 on both a location-based and market-based basis, and applicable Scope 3 categories.Apply and document emissions factors, including grid, district steam, and regulatory coefficients, and maintain a clear record of methodology and any year-over-year changes.Track renewable energy certificate and offset procurement, retirement documentation, and the application of those instruments to reported figures.Calculate progress against the Company's science-based targets and prepare the underlying support.Calculate building-level emissions against applicable Local Law 97 limits and model exposure for current and future compliance periods.Maintain a complete audit trail and evidence file for all reported figures, and support the third-party assurance process.

ENERGY STAR Program

Serve as Vornado's primary point of contact with the U.S. EPA on all ENERGY STAR matters.Administer the Company's ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager account, including property and meter records, space use attributes, data quality checks, and sharing permissions.Prepare and submit annual ENERGY STAR certification applications, with support from the Vice President, Engineering and outside consultants, and coordinate professional verification.Manage Vornado's annual ENERGY STAR Partner of the Year submission end to end, including narrative drafting, supporting data, internal review, and on-time filing.Administer benchmarking and energy efficiency rating compliance for the New York City portfolio, including annual submissions and posting requirements.

Sustainability Reporting and Disclosure

Prepare energy, emissions, water, and waste data for the Company's annual sustainability report, including data tables, footnotes, and methodology disclosures.Assemble the annual GRESB submission data package, including asset-level reporting, coverage and boundary determinations, and supporting evidence.Prepare data submissions for additional frameworks and programs as required, which may include ULI Greenprint, GRI, CDP, SASB, TCFD-aligned disclosure, and state-level climate disclosure regimes.Prepare portfolio performance data for award and recognition submissions.Maintain the consolidated reporting calendar and ensure the data required for each submission is prepared, reviewed, and approved in advance of external deadlines.

Utility Account and Invoice Administration

Submit monthly utility and consultant invoices for processing and track them against approved budgets.Prepare purchase orders and route them for review and signature.Support the annual utility expense budget and reforecast, including building-level allocation.Support the Vice President, Engineering on utility and incentive program applications by preparing the consumption and performance data those programs require. The Vice President owns the applications and the project scopes they fund.

Qualifications And Skills

Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science or engineering, data science, statistics, economics, or a comparable quantitative discipline.Two to five years of professional experience in energy data analysis, utility analytics, sustainability reporting, or a closely related field. Commercial real estate experience is strongly preferred.Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including complex formulas, pivot tables, structured data management, and working confidently with large multi-year datasets.Working knowledge of ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager, including property setup, meter management, and data quality troubleshooting.Familiarity with greenhouse gas accounting fundamentals under the GHG Protocol, including the distinction between location-based and market-based Scope 2 reporting.Demonstrated attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data integrity, version control, and documentation.Ability to manage concurrent deliverables against firm external deadlines.Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain analytical findings and methodology choices to colleagues without a technical background.Positive attitude, collaborative mentality, and comfort working directly with building engineering and property management teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with New York City energy and emissions regulation, including benchmarking, energy efficiency ratings, and Local Law 97.Prior participation in a GRESB submission cycle or comparable ESG reporting framework.Experience with utility billing platforms, submetering systems, or interval data and building analytics platforms.Data tooling beyond Excel — for example Power Query, SQL, Python, or a business intelligence platform such as Power BI or Tableau.Experience preparing data for third-party assurance or audit.Relevant credentials, such as Certified Energy Manager, LEED Green Associate or LEED AP, or ENERGY STAR training.

The base salary range for this New York, NY based position is $95,000 to $110,000. Actual salary will be determined based on skills, experience (to the extent relevant) and other job-related factors, consistent with applicable law.

Vornado Realty Trust is not offering relocation for this position based in New York, NY.

Vornado Realty Trust is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Join the creditflow team, the engine powering our next-generation credit decisioning and valuations model scoring platform. Our mission is to seamlessly connect complex financial data with real-time analytics to optimize credit polity, enhance cash flow underwriting, and deliver lightning-fast credit decisions via valuations model and various analytical capabilities.

As a Senior Data Scientist on the team, you will build a robust scoring platform and deploy models, create innovative analytical tools, leverage alternative data sources, and collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and product to scale our products, valuations models and analytical capabilities. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where your expertise in data, engineering, business and credit knowledge along with machine learning and statistical modeling—powered by a tech stack featuring Python, Snowflake, Conda—will directly impact our credit infrastructure and empower our customers with fairer, more accessible credit products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications:

rows.title: Product Costing & Analytics Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

David Yurman is a celebrated American jewelry company founded in New York by David Yurman, a sculptor, and his wife, Sybil, a painter and ceramicist. When the artists began collaborating, their goal was simply to make beautiful objects to wear. Led today by their son Evan, David Yurman creates timeless, yet contemporary collections for women and men defined by inspiration, innovation, consummate craftsmanship and cable – the brand’s artistic signature. David Yurman collections are available at retail stores throughout the United States, Canada, Hong Kong and France and at locations worldwide, through their exclusive authorized fine jewelry and timepiece network of retailers.

Our Values

At David Yurman, creativity, innovation and impeccable craftsmanship are at the core of everything we do. Fueled by the energy of our hometown, New York City, artistic passion informs each and every jewelry design. The Yurman family’s guiding vision continually defines and redefines what it means to be the preeminent American luxury jewelry brand. We are committed to responsible business and social practices and to the protection and advancement of human rights. We believe in partnering with others who share these values and understand their importance.

Overview

Job Description

The Product Costing & Analytics Analyst supports accurate, timely, and data-driven product costing across the development and production lifecycle. This role is responsible for validating cost components, analyzing pricing and margin variances, maintaining costing data within key systems, and partnering with cross-functional teams and vendors to ensure product costs are complete, consistent, and aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with complex data, cost sheets, BOMs, purchase orders, invoices, and reporting tools.

Responsibilities

Review, validate, and analyze product costing information, including cost sheets, BOMs, purchase orders, invoices, and supporting documentation, to ensure accuracy and completeness. Evaluate daily purchase order price change requests, investigate discrepancies, and partner with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve pricing or documentation issues. Perform variance analysis between show costing, development costing, final production costing, and post-production updates to support margin visibility and profitability maintenance. Maintain and update costing data, cost charts, and related reporting to support accurate business analysis and decision-making. Use Excel, Sigma, PLM, Qiwk reports, Jira, and other systems to maintain accurate data, generate reporting, and identify inconsistencies in costing information. Develop a strong understanding of DY jewelry components, materials, labor, finishing instructions, and product construction to accurately evaluate cost structures. Conduct thorough self-review of calculations, pricing inputs, and supporting details prior to submission to ensure high data integrity. Communicate costing updates, discrepancies, and required actions clearly to cross-functional partners, including Product Development, Procurement, Merchandising, Production, and vendors. Continuously prioritize competing tasks, monitor deadlines, and adjust focus as business needs evolve while maintaining accuracy and responsiveness. 

Qualifications

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to review high-volume costing, pricing, BOM, PO, and invoice data for accuracy, gaps, and inconsistencies. Advanced Excel skills, including large datasets, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and analytical reporting. Proactive problem solver with sound judgment and the ability to validate information, question unusual cost changes, resolve discrepancies, and improve data accuracy. Proven ability to work proactively and independently while contributing as a collaborative team partnerHighly organized communicator able to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, summarize findings, and follow up effectively with internal teams and vendors. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with effective interpersonal skills. Experience with PLM, Sigma, Qiwk, Jira, or similar product lifecycle/reporting systems preferred; knowledge of jewelry materials, components, production processes, or product costing a plus. 

Education: Bachelor’s Degree

Location: New York, NY

Working Mode: Hybrid

Estimate Salary Range:  $85k – 98k

Base pay is one component of David Yurman’s total compensation package, which may also include the following for eligible employees: access to healthcare benefits, 401(k) plan, bonus, employee discounts, Summer Fridays (corporate roles), generous paid time off, sick time, and more.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at David Yurman

As a company founded by artists, David Yurman champions self-expression in everything we do. We are committed to fostering a culture of openness and creative collaboration within our entire community, and we cherish the diversity of our employees’ backgrounds and perspectives. We will always advocate for equity and inclusion for all.

Job Description

GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS

Global Banking & Markets provides financing, advisory services, risk distribution and hedging for our institutional and corporate clients through our FICC and Equities (“GBM Public”) and Investment Banking (“GBM Private”) franchises.

SUPERVISORY RISK & CONTROLS 

The Supervisory Risk & Controls team within Global Banking & Markets (GBM) manages controls covering supervisory-related risks arising from business activities in the Global Banking & Markets (GBM) division. The team partners with businesses to implement controls, support ongoing monitoring and oversight, as well as related supervisory tools to manage risk.

We are looking for an individual to support the expansion of the program to cover business activities in GBM Private, focusing on the Capital Solutions Group (CSG).

Our Capital Solutions Group is a comprehensive suite of our financing, origination, structuring, and risk management solutions. The depth and breadth of our relationships, enriched by the velocity of our deal flow, provide clients unique insights to maximize value and unlock opportunity. Our integrated structure is built to provide comprehensive, tailored solutions that propel both our issuing and investing clients forward.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

 Develop understanding of Capital Solutions Group (CSG) business activities  Support the development of the supervisory framework for CSG business activities, including appropriate desk controls, monitoring & tools  Define and implement appropriate controls to manage risk, including supervisor expectations and escalation  Support governance processes to drive monitoring & oversight for the covered controls  Build relationships with relevant stakeholder groups to implement the program, including bankers, Compliance, Engineering, Legal and others, as relevant  Engage with GBM Public side teams to drive consistency across the divisional supervisory program and related monitoring 

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree.  2-3 years of relevant work experience  Prior knowledge of banking activities including financing, origination, structuring & underwriting preferred.  Familiarity with securities markets, derivative products, deal flows.  Strong time and project management/organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to handle a fast-paced environment; communicate factually and influentially.

rows.title: Senior Analyst - Product Management

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The Team

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

In U.S. Consumer Services (USCS), our product is Membership—delivering benefits and services that are essential to our Card Members across travel, dining, entertainment, and retail. We compete by providing a differentiated Membership experience that drives loyalty and long-term growth. USCS brings this to life through our premium, cobrand, cash back, and lending portfolios, Membership Rewards, Travel & Lifestyle Services, the Centurion Lounge network, Global Dining, U.S. Consumer Banking, Amex Offers, Amex Ads, and best-in-class marketing programs.

Accelerating growth across our Cobrand portfolios is central to our enterprise strategy—expanding customer relevance, deepening loyalty, diversifying revenue streams, and delivering sustainable top-line growth. The Cobrand organization within the U.S. Consumer Services Group leads the strategy and management of our Cobrand partner relationships and Cobranded credit card solutions, integrating product innovation, portfolio strategy, P&L management, customer experiences, and operational excellence to strengthen loyalty and enhance our competitive position.

The Delta Cobrand Product Management team is responsible for shaping and executing the long-term strategy of one of our most significant strategic partnerships. The team drives the portfolio vision, value proposition design, financial performance, and innovation—ensuring we deliver differentiated, customer-centric products that drive acquisition, increase engagement, and create mutual value for both organizations.

About The Role

This Senior Analyst will be responsible for driving high-priority portfolio operations and partner-facing workstreams that will enable growth for the Delta Cobrand portfolio. This is a highly visible role, with responsibilities spanning across the end-to-end product management lifecycle, inclusive of program reporting, competitive insights, benefit management, invoicing, and operational risk management.

The Senior Analyst will play a critical role in strengthening operational rigor, surfacing insights that inform product decisions, and helping advance the long-term growth strategy for the portfolio. This individual will partner closely with Finance, Analytics, Control Management and Compliance teams, while supporting ongoing engagement with Delta counterparts.

This impactful role is for someone who wants to gain experience in product management and exposure to the P/L. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, comfortable operating across ambiguity, and energized by working at the intersection of product strategy, partner management, and execution. A successful candidate is someone who can connect day-to-day operational details to broader portfolio priorities, helping the team identify opportunities to improve customer experience, strengthen controls, and unlock growth.

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

David Yurman is a celebrated American jewelry company founded in New York by David Yurman, a sculptor, and his wife, Sybil, a painter and ceramicist. When the artists began collaborating, their goal was simply to make beautiful objects to wear. Led today by their son Evan, David Yurman creates timeless, yet contemporary collections for women and men defined by inspiration, innovation, consummate craftsmanship and cable – the brand’s artistic signature. David Yurman collections are available at retail stores throughout the United States, Canada, Hong Kong and France and at locations worldwide, through their exclusive authorized fine jewelry and timepiece network of retailers.

Our Values

At David Yurman, creativity, innovation and impeccable craftsmanship are at the core of everything we do. Fueled by the energy of our hometown, New York City, artistic passion informs each and every jewelry design. The Yurman family’s guiding vision continually defines and redefines what it means to be the preeminent American luxury jewelry brand. We are committed to responsible business and social practices and to the protection and advancement of human rights. We believe in partnering with others who share these values and understand their importance.

Overview

Job Description

The Product Costing & Analytics Analyst supports accurate, timely, and data-driven product costing across the development and production lifecycle. This role is responsible for validating cost components, analyzing pricing and margin variances, maintaining costing data within key systems, and partnering with cross-functional teams and vendors to ensure product costs are complete, consistent, and aligned with business objectives. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with complex data, cost sheets, BOMs, purchase orders, invoices, and reporting tools.

Responsibilities

Review, validate, and analyze product costing information, including cost sheets, BOMs, purchase orders, invoices, and supporting documentation, to ensure accuracy and completeness. Evaluate daily purchase order price change requests, investigate discrepancies, and partner with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve pricing or documentation issues. Perform variance analysis between show costing, development costing, final production costing, and post-production updates to support margin visibility and profitability maintenance. Maintain and update costing data, cost charts, and related reporting to support accurate business analysis and decision-making. Use Excel, Sigma, PLM, Qiwk reports, Jira, and other systems to maintain accurate data, generate reporting, and identify inconsistencies in costing information. Develop a strong understanding of DY jewelry components, materials, labor, finishing instructions, and product construction to accurately evaluate cost structures. Conduct thorough self-review of calculations, pricing inputs, and supporting details prior to submission to ensure high data integrity. Communicate costing updates, discrepancies, and required actions clearly to cross-functional partners, including Product Development, Procurement, Merchandising, Production, and vendors. Continuously prioritize competing tasks, monitor deadlines, and adjust focus as business needs evolve while maintaining accuracy and responsiveness. 

Qualifications

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to review high-volume costing, pricing, BOM, PO, and invoice data for accuracy, gaps, and inconsistencies. Advanced Excel skills, including large datasets, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and analytical reporting. Proactive problem solver with sound judgment and the ability to validate information, question unusual cost changes, resolve discrepancies, and improve data accuracy. Proven ability to work proactively and independently while contributing as a collaborative team partnerHighly organized communicator able to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, summarize findings, and follow up effectively with internal teams and vendors. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with effective interpersonal skills. Experience with PLM, Sigma, Qiwk, Jira, or similar product lifecycle/reporting systems preferred; knowledge of jewelry materials, components, production processes, or product costing a plus. 

Education: Bachelor’s Degree

Location: New York, NY

Working Mode: Hybrid

Estimate Salary Range:  $85k – 98k

Base pay is one component of David Yurman’s total compensation package, which may also include the following for eligible employees: access to healthcare benefits, 401(k) plan, bonus, employee discounts, Summer Fridays (corporate roles), generous paid time off, sick time, and more.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at David Yurman

As a company founded by artists, David Yurman champions self-expression in everything we do. We are committed to fostering a culture of openness and creative collaboration within our entire community, and we cherish the diversity of our employees’ backgrounds and perspectives. We will always advocate for equity and inclusion for all.

David Yurman is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to an individual’s age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender).

We are seeking an Associate Research Scientist (ARS) to co-lead the scientific and day-to-day operations of SEE-US (Syphilis Education & Elimination in the US), a newly funded five-year NIH/NIAID R01. It is a two-site hybrid type 2 effectiveness-implementation randomized controlled trial that uses a citizen science approach to engage community members in the creation of digital health messages to promote syphilis and HIV/STI testing uptake, which will then be tested in the trial. The ARS will work closely with Dr. Alissa Davis, the Principal Investigator of the study. They will contribute to the study’s research design, analysis, and publications, and will help oversee study startup and regulatory compliance, participant recruitment and retention, trial operations and participant safety, data management and quality, and the supervision and training of research assistants. The role is highly collaborative. The ARS will also serve as a liaison with partners at the University of Alabama at Birmingham, RTI International, Community Collaborative Research Boards and other organizational partners at each site. This is a chance to shape a Phase III clinical trial from launch through dissemination and to help build community-driven, scalable approaches to reducing syphilis and STI disparities in the US.
