Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders.

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Science
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description:

The Credit Risk Management, Loss Forecasting and Allowance team uses the latest technologies and innovative models and data to forecast and optimize future losses associated with Capital One’s credit card portfolio. We partner with model development and software engineering teams to build predictive models and automate insight generation.

As a Data Scientist, you will focus on loss forecasting modernization and data transformation. The qualified candidate will support card loss forecasting: resilience, outlook, allowance and CCAR.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to identify and quantify risks associated with modelsLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within dataBuild statistical/machine learning models to challenge “champion models” that are deployed in production todayContribute to the model governance of the next generation of machine learning modelsFlex your interpersonal skills to present how model risks could impact the business to executives 

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You have experience with a wide array of methods. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Credit Card Innovation
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Join the creditflow team, the engine powering our next-generation credit decisioning and valuations model scoring platform. Our mission is to seamlessly connect complex financial data with real-time analytics to optimize credit polity, enhance cash flow underwriting, and deliver lightning-fast credit decisions via valuations model and various analytical capabilities.

As a Senior Data Scientist on the team, you will build a robust scoring platform and deploy models, create innovative analytical tools, leverage alternative data sources, and collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and product to scale our products, valuations models and analytical capabilities. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where your expertise in data, engineering, business and credit knowledge along with machine learning and statistical modeling—powered by a tech stack featuring Python, Snowflake, Conda—will directly impact our credit infrastructure and empower our customers with fairer, more accessible credit products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration

rows.title: Analyst Digital Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. The Human Resources Information Systems ( HRIS ) team within Human Resources Management and Development works collaboratively to develop strategies, infrastructure, and processes that provide for the timely collection and dissemination of employee data and information, enhanced capacity for distributed reporting, and support of data-driven decision making related to human resources.

Reporting to the Assistant Director, the HRIS Associate reviews, analyzes, and processes the day-to-day personnel action requests for medical residents, staff, non-student temporary and research positions as well as generating GWID numbers for the employees. This includes new benefit eligible hires submitted through our applicant tracking system ( ATS ), employee life cycle changes through our position management module of the ATS , personnel action forms (PAFs), and terminations. The HRIS Associate, Business Operations may support transaction requests for faculty personnel, which includes creating benefited and non-benefited positions. The HRIS Associate also reviews and processes employment eligibility (Form I-9 and E-Verify) in accordance with Federal Government guidelines.

Additionally, the HRIS Associate performs the following job duties:

Performs the full range of employee life-cycle changes (new hires, internal transfers, bonuses, salary changes, title changes, job duties changes, full-time/part-time changes, terminations, etc.)Generates GWID numbers for employees and maintains employee data records into the ERP system ( SSN , citizenship status, etc.)Receives, analyzes and enters employment eligibility (Form I-9 and E-Verify) data to ensure compliance with federal regulationsWorks closely with the Faculty Personnel office in creating benefited and non-benefited position numbersMaintains the position budget form for all positions at GW which ties a budget to a positionReviews, analyzes, and evaluates information before data entry for accuracy, completion, and validityResponsible for assisting in all aspects with the medical resident onboarding (recycling positions, generating GWIDS , entering hire into ERP system, processing I-9 documents)Communicates and collaborates with various internal departments (HR Business Partners, Payroll, Benefits, etc.) as needed to remedy any processing issues that may ariseProvides recommendations to HR Business Partners as well as other internal subject matter experts (Talent Acquisition, Compensation, etc.) to improve business processesResponsible for addressing a high volume of time sensitive system-related activities while maintaining a high level of quality and internal customer satisfactionMaintains and updates electronic and hard copy personnel record systems containing all employment-related informationEnsures compliance with data privacy and safeguards personal identifying information ( PII )Demonstrates excellent knowledge and understanding of HR related systems, how processes are managed through the system, and assists end usersActively participates in quality control and process improvement activitiesUnderstands GW’s Payroll calendar for processing both monthly and bi-weekly pay frequencies

The HRIS Associate, Business Operations also provides special project support for departmental, School, and University initiatives as requested. Performs other related duties as assigned. The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

This position is a Hybrid position. Hybrid work is defined as job functions that can be performed effectively in a combination of on- and off-campus locations. Employees may have dedicated space or typically have a personal or shared workspace assigned or available to them at an on-campus site. rows.title: Senior Sales Analytics Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Overview:

As the largest food & beverage company in the world, we sell over a billion products every day. Nestle’s sales team is the driving force behind every unit sold, focused on building strong categories by delighting our consumers while representing Nestle’s iconic brands with our retail partners.

The Sales Analytics team is the analytical intelligence engine that powers our Divisional sales & headquarter teams. The insights, data, and analytical expertise that our Sr Sales Analysts provide shape our strategic business decisions and equip our sales team to meet our consumer needs and drive category growth. The Sr. Analyst supports the division sales & CDCE team by leading strategic analytical initiatives and retailer/division-centric reporting that span across divisional categories.

Key Responsibilities:

The Sr. Analyst designs and deploys custom analytical solutions and team specific scorecards/dashboards to meet the unique needs of their Division Team. They serve as the analytical expert by leading multi-category requests and by providing insights and support to field sales leaders. The Sr. Analyst also plays a lead role on the Sales Analytics team, responsible for coaching, training, and onboarding Analysts.

Utilize multiple data sources to compile analysis and provide recommendations that drive positive ROI for the sales organization focusing on the so what, now what. Strategize, advise and provide ad hoc support for VP/Director/Sr. Managers on opportunities for profitable growthIdentify team priorities and goals and develop trackersChampion the use and application of standard sales analytics reports to meet the organization’s needsCollaborate with the Business Intelligence Analysts to deliver best-in-class dashboards and scorecards for stakeholdersProvide superior customer service, being the point of contact for all faucets of sales analytics support 

Division/Retailer Focused Insights & Reporting: Lead and provide retail/division-focused analytical support.

Translate complex business needs into actionable reporting, analytics, and insights that drive informed decision-making.Maintain a holistic understanding of the wholesaler/retailer, category, and business landscape to proactively identify opportunities and improve selling capabilities.Deliver actionable customer, category, and retail insights that support commercial planning, business planning, and sales execution.Conduct root-cause, post-event, and benchmark analyses to evaluate performance, address business challenges, and identify growth opportunities.Leverage internal, retail POS & movement data to provide fact-based recommendations, customer-facing selling tools, and category insights.Support business performance through forecast accuracy, sales target attainment, segmentation, resource allocation, and customer service improvement.Partner with CIH to transform 4Ps analytics and insights into business actions that drive growth.Ensure timely and effective communication of customer, category, and forecast information to key stakeholders.

Elevate & Expand Sales Analytics Partnerships: Responsible for driving continuous improvement within the broader sales analytics tam through executing key projects and demonstrating peer-to-peer leadership. The Sr. Analyst will demonstrate role model behaviors within the sales analytics team by upskilling the analyst community through coaching and onboarding.

Owns and executes key sales analytics processes and provides sales analytics leadership with assistance on complex projects/initiatives.Lead onboarding, provide continuous development, and fosters team collaboration for the Analysts on their respective sales analytics team Own the deployment and training of sales analytics resources

Requirements:

3+ years of experience in sales analytics and reporting Proficiency with Circana, Nielsen and other syndicated data, Excel, PowerPoint and PowerBi data management and data visualization.Experience manipulating, managing, and drawing insights from large amounts of data Experience driving insights and storytelling through the use of data. Proven ability to routinely lead and foster collaboration among teammatesAbility to take initiative and drive improvement across the organization Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills. Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.Organization and accuracy skills with excellent attention to detailDemonstrates a thorough understanding of the sales fundamentalsStrong judgement in decision making, good problem-solving skills, and thinks strategicallyDoesn’t hesitate to act and takes the initiative to execute with minimal supervision Takes immediate action to resolve issues or potential issues, ensuring stakeholders are properly communicated to about the potential impact

Preferred:

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution preferred.Project Management skills or experience

Salary: $87,105.60 to $125,732.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home.

Job Description

As a valued colleague on our team, you will support the development and administration of Anaplan solutions that drive business planning, forecasting, and decision making. This role is ideal for individuals with strong analytical and problem-solving skills who enjoy working with data and translating business requirements into system-based solutions.

THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE

Responsibilities

The Financial Engineer - Anaplan role will offer you the opportunity to make an impact, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:

Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of Anaplan planning and forecasting solutions. Analyze business requirements, data, and processes to help build scalable models that support financial planning, reporting, and decision-making. Assist with data validation, system testing, regression testing, and troubleshooting to ensure solution accuracy and reliability.Partner with business stakeholders and senior developers to translate planning and reporting needs into effective Anaplan solutions. Document requirements, processes, and model enhancements, and help communicate results and insights in a clear and understandable manner. Contribute to scenario analysis and business-driven forecasting activities that support planning and operational decision-making.

Desired Experience

THE EXPERIENCE YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Experience working with data, reporting, financial planning, forecasting, or business analysis is a plus.Interest in learning enterprise planning platforms and developing expertise in Anaplan.Ability to communicate technical concepts and business insights effectively to diverse audiences.Candidates should possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to work with complex data and business processes. Familiarity with programming or scripting concepts such as SAS, Python, or R is helpful but not required, as coding is not a primary responsibility of this role.Prior experience with Anaplan is not required, as training will be provided.

rows.title: Employment Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is represented by the OPEIU union and subject to the terms and conditions of a collective bargaining agreement.

Job Overview: The Employment Specialist assists newly arrived refugees and other qualified immigrants to attain self-sufficiency through employment by guiding them through employment preparation, coordinating job placements, and other career advancement services.

Major Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Conduct intake, assessment and provide program orientation to clients eligible for employment services. Develop comprehensive employment plans and budget strategies for each employable adult. Provide job readiness and job search coaching and connect clients with job opportunities.Develop and cultivate long term relationships with area employers and staffing agencies to identify appropriate employment opportunities for clients.Assist clients and employers as necessary with post-placement issues and continuing employment needs.Monitor client job performance, wage levels, and related metrics.Detail each client interaction in accordance with program requirements. Input client information in database(s) and assist with tracking and reporting as needed.Collaborate effectively with coworkers and partner organizations. Build and maintain relationships with area service providers for the benefit of clients.Use personal, insured vehicle and/or public transportation (where available) to travel and transport clients and materials as needed throughout the service delivery area.May train and lead the activities of support staff, volunteers, and interns.Other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in social work or related field of study preferred.

Work Experience

Relevant professional experience in workforce development field required; minimum of 2 years’ experience strongly preferred.Experience working with refugee and/or immigrant populations strongly preferred.Experience with job placement and job readiness training a plus.

Demonstrated Skills & Competencies

Strong relationship building, diplomacy, and networking skills; ability to effectively build internal and external relationships.Demonstrated success working and communicating effectively in a multi-cultural environment.Self-starter with excellent problem-solving skills combined with the proven ability to multi-task, prioritize duties, and manage time effectively.Attention to detail and accuracy in work product.Proficient in English, both spoken and written; proficiency in language(s) spoken by client group is desired; including Dari, Farsi, and/or Pashto.Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook); ability to use the internet and other digital tools for data entry, research and problem-solving purposes.Valid driver’s license and access to a personal, insured vehicle.

Working Environment

A combination of standard office environment, remote work, and ‘field’ time within the service delivery area to perform the above outlined responsibilities.May require occasional weekend and/or evening work.

Compensation: (26.80/hr). Compensation is based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings

Benefits: IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.

Equal Opportunity Employer: IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Orders, replenishes and merchandises grocery products and participate in WFM program for purchasing and promotions. Monitors inventory control and replenishes product based upon WFM ordering standards. Assists in organizing and developing promotional displays and maintaining OTS standards. Completes Order Writer trainingReplenishes products through proper buying procedures.Orders perishable and/or non-perishable grocery products and maintains appropriate back stock levels.Monitors and acts upon open PO reports for both purchases and credits in an accurate and timely manner.Controls spoilage/shrink; participates in inventory and cycle counting.Completes spoilage and all other inventory management processes, sampling, temperature, and sweep worksheets as required.Ensures orders for product are timely and accurate to monitor inventory turns.Oversees customer special order procedure.Analyzes and controls product transfers, waste, and spoilage.Supports leadership in conducting inventories.Maintains financial profitability by meeting and exceeding purchasing and sales targets.Arrives to work station on time, appropriately groomed, dressed and ready to work; works all scheduled shifts and attends required trainings and meetings.Provides excellent customer service, addresses needs of customers in a timely and effective manner and models suggestive selling techniques; answers phones and pages promptly and courteously.Maximizes sales potential through effective and proper procedures for prepping, storing, rotating, stocking, and merchandising product.Follows and complies, or ensures compliance, with established procedures, including Weights and Measures, health and sanitation, and safe work practices.Maintains, or ensures maintenance of, a clean and sanitary working and shopping environment; maintains equipment in accordance with WFM cleanliness and safety standards.Performs opening, mid, and closing duties as assigned; ensures accuracy of signs and pricing.Immediately reports safety hazards and violations.Performs other duties as assigned by store, regional, or national leadership.

Job Skills

Comprehensive knowledge of grocery products.Working knowledge and application of all grocery merchandising expectations.Ability to educate team on product knowledge and convey enthusiasm.Strong basic math skills.Knowledge and ability to use computer programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and ordering systems.Strong to excellent communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team.Ability to deliver information in a clear and respectable manner to fellow Team Members, customers, and vendors.Ability to meet customer service expectations and standards in all interactions with customers, vendors, and Team Members.Ability to follow directions and procedures; effective time management and organization skills.Passion for natural foods and the mission of Whole Foods Market.Strong work ethic and ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency.Understanding of and compliance with WFM quality goals.

Experience

12+ months retail experience.

No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. rows.title: FP&A Analyst, Capital Investments
rows.descriptionText:
The ASR Group® family of companies make up the world’s largest refiner and marketer of cane sugar. The companies produce a full line of grocery, industrial, foodservice and specialty sweetener products. Across North America, ASR Group® companies operate five sugar refineries, located in California, Maryland, Louisiana, Canada and Mexico. In Europe, ASR Group® companies operate sugar refineries in the United Kingdom, Portugal, and, with a joint venture partner, Italy. The companies also farm sugarcane and own sugar mills in Mexico and Belize. The ASR Group® portfolio includes the leading brands Domino®, C&H®, Florida Crystals®, Redpath®, Tate & Lyle®, Lyle's®, Sidul® and Whitworths®. ASR Group® companies also produce and market Tellus®, a single-use, compostable tableware and foodservice product made from plant fibers, including sugarcane.
OverviewThe FP&A Analyst, Capital Investments leads financial analyses that underpin some of the Company's most significant capital investment decisions. The position serves as a key member of the team responsible for evaluating, prioritizing, and monitoring the strategic investments that drive the Company's long-term growth, reliability, and operational excellence. In addition, the FP&A Analyst, Capital Investments will play a leading role in leveraging AI-enabled tools to improve financial processes, enhance analysis, and support better decision making across the organization.The responsibilities for this highly visible role include building business cases, performing cost-benefit analyses, modeling operational and financial scenarios used to evaluate and approve strategic capital projects. The analyst will work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance, helping translate complex business challenges into actionable investment recommendations.The position offers a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to senior leadership, including the CFO, COO, and functional Vice Presidents, and to regularly present analyses and recommendations that influence the Company's capital allocation decisions. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, analytically rigorous, and excited by the opportunity to learn, contribute, and accelerate their career while helping shape the future of a leading manufacturing organization.
Detailed Roles & ResponsibilitiesBuild and maintain capital investment models, including cash flow forecasts, NPV, IRR, payback, sensitivity analysis and scenario comparisons.Partner with Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Accounting and project sponsors to validate scope, cost, timing, risks, benefits, useful-life assumptions, capital-versus-expense treatment and closeout documentation.Prepare executive-ready business cases and recommendations that explain strategic rationale, alternatives, assumptions, returns and decision risks.Support annual capital planning, forecasts and long-range planning by consolidating submissions, challenging assumptionsApply AI tools and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, automate recurring work, identify trends or anomalies and strengthen management reporting.Facilitate post-completion reviews to compare actual cost, timing and benefits with approved business cases and incorporate lessons learned into future evaluations. 
WORK EXPERIENCE Minimum of two years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial analysis, capital planning, manufacturing finance, project finance, cost accounting or a related field.Demonstrated ability to build financial models, convert operational assumptions into investment cash flows and work with SAP, business intelligence or manufacturing data systems. 
EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS B.A. or B.S. requiredRelevant course work in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline required a plus 
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY No direct supervisory responsibility; expected to lead analyses, coordinate cross-functional inputs and influence decisions through clear financial insight. 
ESSENTIAL CAPABILITIES (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES AND PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES) Strong understanding of corporate finance, capital budgeting, discounted cash flow analysis, financial statements, depreciation, working capital and investment decision criteria.Willingness to learn about our business, leaving your desk and spending time in a manufacturing environmentAdvanced Excel and financial-modeling capability, including structured assumptions, scenario analysis, audit checks and clear model documentation.Practical skill using generative AI, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, forecasting or automation techniques to improve FP&A workflows and capital-investment analysis.Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify limitations or unsupported conclusions and apply sound financial judgment before information is used in decisions.Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate complex analysis into concise recommendations for project sponsors and senior leadership.Curiosity, critical thinking and a constructive challenge mindset, with the ability to test assumptions and explore alternative solutions.Ability to build effective working relationships across Finance, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Accounting, Information Technology and leadership.Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, meet tight deadlines and maintain documentation suitable for management review or audit support. 
WORKING ENVIRONMENT The role operates in an office and manufacturing environment and may require periodic presence in production or project areas. The employee must follow all applicable site safety, confidentiality, data-handling and access requirements. Occasional travel to manufacturing locations may be required based on business needs.
LOCATION OF ROLE West Palm Beach, FL/ Baltimore, MD/ Chalmette, LA / Crockett, CA
SALARY PAY RANGE: $62,500-$115,000The pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s qualifications and prior experience.
Benefits include healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs) available the first of the month following 30 days of employment, 401(k) with match, life insurance, AD&D, short-term disability, vacation, holiday and sick time.We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other category protected under federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Capital One Corporate Treasury is looking for an enthusiastic team player who is detail-oriented, self-motivated, intellectually curious, highly dependable and can handle pressure to support the Cash Management team. This operationally-focused role primarily manages daily cash activity at Capital One’s Federal Reserve account and corporate domestic and international correspondent bank accounts. The Associate also facilitates intercompany lending activities and supports Treasury system enhancements and enterprise-wide initiatives. The ideal candidate is comfortable building relationships with business partners to broaden awareness of team processes and increase our knowledge of company-wide activities to better inform the daily cash processes.

In this role, the Associate works closely with team members to develop tools to analyze and model data for various business needs. This role may also provide the associate opportunities to explore and leverage data analysis and code development to further enhance the team’s abilities. The ideal candidate must have the capacity and desire to learn basic and gradually more complex financial concepts.

As a member of the Cash Management team, the Associate is in a great position to learn and understand the various funding, investment, and reporting mechanics of Capital One at a broad level via the daily cash activities of the entire organization. The team provides senior leadership guidance on matters relating to cash positioning and management and often plays a significant role in the successful execution of corporate initiatives and transactions.

Bachelor’s degree or military experience At least 1 years of experience in financial analysis, Treasury, or a combination

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Recommendation & Personalization Systems
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description:

Join an elite Applied AI team within AI Foundations, operating at the intersection of deep research and massive real-world impact. We are pioneering the next generation of personalized customer experiences across Capital One's web and mobile applications, leveraging our high-scale ML models. rows.descriptionText:
Purpose and Impact:

Amentum provides warning and all-source analytical support to DIA’s Defense Combating Terrorism Office to drive DoD policy, planning, and operational decisions to counter regional and transnational terrorism threats. We conduct mission-critical counterterrorism analysis focused on operational and strategic effects against emerging terrorist threat networks and identities operating globally with intent to harm U.S. persons, facilities, and interests. Our work includes delivering national watchlisting support to the TIDE database, providing expert assessments for the Pentagon/Joint Staff, and 24/7/365 support to DoD and senior policy decision makers, as well as international and interagency partners, on predictive threat assessments regarding transnational and regional terrorist threats. Amentum analysts also support the Congressionally-mandated Prisoner of War/Missing in Action cell with analysis, collection, and 24/7 support to the U.S. government for global hostage threats or events against U.S. citizens.

Work Schedule: First Shift – 8 hours per day

Essential Responsibilities:

Systematically and deliberately reviews DoD datasets assessed as likely to contain identifying information for known or suspected terrorists. Identity, prioritize, and record information from known DoD datasets related to known or suspected terrorists as specified by the Government. Crosscheck/research known or suspected terrorists against other intelligence holdings to ensure completeness of information and to avoid duplicating data entries. Compile information into a nomination report format as specified by the Government. Correctly format, classify, and address reports. Ensure information contained within reports is intelligible, cogent, comprehensive, and understandable, and that all reports use proper grammar and spelling. Meet Terrorist Identity Nomination (TIN) production schedule. Correct and resubmit incorrect reports and prepare reports for dissemination as record message traffic or other dissemination methods as specified by the Government. Provide guidance and instruction for less experienced team members assigned to Watchlisting. Demonstrate general knowledge and understanding of IC organizations associated with CT operations, analysis, products, and information systems. Attend and participate in meetings, conferences, intelligence exchanges, roundtables, working groups, and other types of analytic exchanges in support or DIA’s Watchlisting mission. Possess general information systems experience working with select DoD datasets and intelligence reporting activities: demonstrate comprehensive mission knowledge in order to provide guidance related to National Terrorist Watchlisting policies and procedures. Demonstrate in-depth knowledge and understanding of terrorist organizations, to include group names and geographic location, leadership, activities, and ideology. 

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Watchlist Analyst – Performs all-source intelligence analysis of DoD datasets to identify and nominate known or suspected terrorists into the National Terrorist Watchlisting system. Develops DoD recommendations for the no-fly, selectee, or other national terrorist watch lists as appropriate, to fulfill the DoD component of Homeland Security Presidential Directives (HSPDs) 6 and 11 and reviews DoD datasets for identifying information of Known or Suspected Terrorists; and identifies, prioritizes, and records information from DoD datasets as specified by the Government. Produces analytic reports using DIA’s Watchlisting Data Organizer (WATCHDOG) and / or other internal DIA production tools. Prepares reports for dissemination by methods specified by the Government.

TS/SCI w/Poly

Minimum Education: 

High School/GED

2 Years

Desired Experience: 4 years of experience related to the specific labor category with at least a portion of the experience within the last 2 years. Desired Education: Bachelor’s degree in an area related to the labor category from a college or university accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. Demonstrates understanding of the 200 Series of ODNI’s ICDs: 203 - Analytic Standards, 206 – Sourcing Requirements for Disseminated Products, and 208 - Write for Maximum Utility. Produce formal written strategic counterterrorism and or all source intelligence assessments, products, graphics and briefings in accordance with ICD 203, DIA and ODNI standards as appropriate. Demonstrates ability to use research databases (e.g., Global Terrorism Database) and use quantifiable matrices in a professional setting to prepare written and oral products on complex topics.

FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available at the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) Office of Rare Diseases, Pediatrics, Urologic and Reproductive Medicine (ORPURM), in the Division of Pediatrics and Maternal Health (DPMH) located in Silver Spring, Maryland. The participation is hybrid with some in-person at the FDA White Oak Campus in Silver Spring, Maryland.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: Pediatric extrapolation relies on the use of inferences about efficacy in children often based on data in adults based on assumptions or evidence of similarity in disease, drug pharmacology and treatment response between adults and children. The need to systematically assess the assumptions underlying extrapolation is well recognized in pediatric drug development. The FDA has access to data from approximately 1,200 pediatric clinical trials, including data from 600 trials spanning more than 300 pediatric development programs, which enables a systematic, disease-focused review. The proposed project aims to analyze adult and pediatric clinical trial data to evaluate the assumptions underlying the extrapolation of pharmacokinetics (PK), efficacy, and safety for selected diseases/conditions.

Educational and Training Components: You will participate in activities related to the research project, including data collection from public and proprietary sources, data analysis and interpretation, and preparation and presentation of research findings for scientific dissemination and publication.

Learning Objectives: Under the guidance of the mentor(s), you will be involved in a systematic review of adult and pediatric clinical trial data, assess similarities of disease between adults and children; understand expected treatment response differences in children, if any; you will assess possibility of leveraging information from previous studies (adult and pediatric) and provide a framework for optimizing trials.

Mentor: The mentor for this opportunity is Lily (Yeruk) Mulugeta (yeruk.mulugeta@fda.hhs.gov). If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentor.

Anticipated Appointment Start Date: January 2027. Start date is flexible and will depend on a variety of factors.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Level of Participation: The participation is hybrid with some in-person at the FDA White Oak Campus in Silver Spring, Maryland.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Citizenship Requirements: This opportunity is available to U.S. citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents (LPR) only.

This program, administered by ORAU through its contract with the U.S. Department of Energy to manage the Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education, was established through an interagency agreement between DOE and FDA. The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience. Proof of health insurance is required for participation in this program. Participants do not become employees of FDA, DOE or the program administrator, and there are no employment-related benefits.

Completion of a successful background investigation by the Office of Personnel Management is required for an applicant to be on-boarded at FDA. OPM can complete a background investigation only for individuals, including non-US Citizens, who have resided in the US for a total of three of the past five years.

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Team Description

You will be a member of the Travel Intelligence team, a high-impact group dedicated to building the "intelligent core" of Capital One Travel. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of travel data into personalized, seamless experiences for our customers. Specifically, this role focuses on the Hotels domain, where you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for Search & Sort and Pricing Optimization. We operate in a "green-field" environment, moving from offline, historical data models to sophisticated, real-time Machine Learning solutions. As part of Travel Intelligence, you won't just be building models; you'll be partnering closely with Product and Engineering to define key metrics (like MOB and Reference Price coverage) and architecting the systems that determine what our customers see and what they pay. This is a unique opportunity to apply the 80:20 rule—starting with pragmatic, high-impact wins while simultaneously building the business case and technical roadmap for the future of ML at Capital One Travel.

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available within the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER), located at Silver Spring, Maryland.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: This project supports the Office of Pharmaceutical Quality (OPQ) Assignment Tool initiative by improving data validation and algorithm performance. You will analyze assignment data from December 2025 to the present to identify workload distribution patterns and refine the algorithm using mathematical modeling, programming, and integrated data systems. Project outcomes will enhance assignment allocation and improve the efficiency and consistency of pharmaceutical quality assessments.

Learning Objectives: You will gain experience in data analysis, algorithm development, and the use of statistical software and data warehouses, while using pharmaceutical quality submission data. You will also develop an understanding of OPQ business processes, databases, and the regulatory assessment of drug applications.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Citizenship Requirements: This opportunity is available to U.S. citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents (LPR) only.

Job Type

Term (Fixed Term)

Position Description

Are you passionate about using your modeling and simulation skills to address critical policy challenges? RAND is seeking talented analysts with expertise in modeling and simulation to join our team and contribute to impactful research in national security policy.

RAND analysts contribute to and lead innovative projects that deliver objective, reliable insights for the public and policymakers at multiple levels. They embrace diverse challenges on topics ranging from space vehicles to surface warfare that require strong analytic capabilities, technical knowledge, and academic or industry experience in modeling and simulation, mathematics, data science, and other applied sciences.

Why RAND?

 Reputation for Excellence: Be part of a non-profit, non-partisan organization renowned for its rigorous and objective research. Dynamic Opportunities: Collaborate in multidisciplinary teams on diverse projects that challenge and expand your skills. Poised for Impact: Your analysis will inform thousands of policymakers, clients, and other stakeholders around the world.

Responsibilities

Technical Analysts use their skills in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics to:

Develop, apply, and analyze the outputs of modeling and simulation tools to examine complex systems, assess alternatives, evaluate risks and tradeoffs, and inform decision-making.Develop understanding of national and homeland security operations and apply that knowledge to structure and design models and validate outputs.Assist in communicating the results of these analyses to decision-makers through written products, briefings, visualizations, and other media.

Term

This position is a 3-year term position with the possibility of renewal.

Qualifications

Expertise in one or more of the listed methodological areas AND one or more of the domain areas is highly desired:

Methodological AreasModeling, simulation, and analysis of complex systems, especially using the Advanced Framework for Simulation and Modeling (AFSIM)Programming and model development using Python, R, MATLAB, Julia, C++, Java, or similar languages and toolsAgent-based, discrete-event, Monte Carlo, system-dynamics, or other computational modeling approaches

Domain Areas:Space systems, aerospace systems, autonomous systems, or other defense-related technical domainsLogistics, supply chains, readiness, force planning, transportation, or operational analysisSystems engineering, requirements analysis, test and evaluation, or technology assessmentData visualization, dashboard development, or communication of complex analytic findings
All analyst positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity. Experience with components of the Department of War is highly desired.

Successful applicants will demonstrate experience or strong potential in modeling and simulation, including the development, use, validation, and interpretation of models to address complex technical, operational, or policy problems.

A master’s degree (or bachelor’s degree with at least five years of relevant professional analytic experience) in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, physical sciences, computer science, data science, or related field is required.
