Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description:

Join an elite Applied AI team within AI Foundations, operating at the intersection of deep research and massive real-world impact. We are pioneering the next generation of personalized customer experiences across Capital One's web and mobile applications, leveraging our high-scale ML models. Our core mission involves architecting and deploying cutting-edge personalized recommendation engines. This is powered by original research into homegrown Foundation Models, advanced Reinforcement Learning techniques, and a state-of-the-art scalable architecture built for billions of interactions. Our research agenda is at the forefront of the field, actively focusing on areas such as Causal Inference, Transformer-based architectures, and sophisticated Recommender Systems.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies - Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more - to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration

With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available within the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER), located at Silver Spring, Maryland.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: This project supports the Office of Pharmaceutical Quality (OPQ) Assignment Tool initiative by improving data validation and algorithm performance. You will analyze assignment data from December 2025 to the present to identify workload distribution patterns and refine the algorithm using mathematical modeling, programming, and integrated data systems. Project outcomes will enhance assignment allocation and improve the efficiency and consistency of pharmaceutical quality assessments.

Learning Objectives: You will gain experience in data analysis, algorithm development, and the use of statistical software and data warehouses, while using pharmaceutical quality submission data. rows.descriptionText:
Job Type

Term (Fixed Term)

Position Description

Are you passionate about using your modeling and simulation skills to address critical policy challenges? RAND is seeking talented analysts with expertise in modeling and simulation to join our team and contribute to impactful research in national security policy.

RAND analysts contribute to and lead innovative projects that deliver objective, reliable insights for the public and policymakers at multiple levels. They embrace diverse challenges on topics ranging from space vehicles to surface warfare that require strong analytic capabilities, technical knowledge, and academic or industry experience in modeling and simulation, mathematics, data science, and other applied sciences.

Why RAND?

 Reputation for Excellence: Be part of a non-profit, non-partisan organization renowned for its rigorous and objective research. Dynamic Opportunities: Collaborate in multidisciplinary teams on diverse projects that challenge and expand your skills. Poised for Impact: Your analysis will inform thousands of policymakers, clients, and other stakeholders around the world.

Responsibilities

Technical Analysts use their skills in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics to:

Develop, apply, and analyze the outputs of modeling and simulation tools to examine complex systems, assess alternatives, evaluate risks and tradeoffs, and inform decision-making.Develop understanding of national and homeland security operations and apply that knowledge to structure and design models and validate outputs.Assist in communicating the results of these analyses to decision-makers through written products, briefings, visualizations, and other media.

Term

This position is a 3-year term position with the possibility of renewal.

Qualifications

Expertise in one or more of the listed methodological areas AND one or more of the domain areas is highly desired:

Methodological AreasModeling, simulation, and analysis of complex systems, especially using the Advanced Framework for Simulation and Modeling (AFSIM)Programming and model development using Python, R, MATLAB, Julia, C++, Java, or similar languages and toolsAgent-based, discrete-event, Monte Carlo, system-dynamics, or other computational modeling approaches

Domain Areas:Space systems, aerospace systems, autonomous systems, or other defense-related technical domainsLogistics, supply chains, readiness, force planning, transportation, or operational analysisSystems engineering, requirements analysis, test and evaluation, or technology assessmentData visualization, dashboard development, or communication of complex analytic findings
All analyst positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity. Experience with components of the Department of War is highly desired.

Successful applicants will demonstrate experience or strong potential in modeling and simulation, including the development, use, validation, and interpretation of models to address complex technical, operational, or policy problems.

Education Requirements

A master’s degree (or bachelor’s degree with at least five years of relevant professional analytic experience) in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, physical sciences, computer science, data science, or related field is required. With a master's degree, at least two years relevant professional experience is preferred. This experience should demonstrate the applicant’s ability to develop, apply, analyze, or communicate the results of quantitative models, simulations, data analyses, or other analytically rigorous research products.

Security Clearance

Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Please note that U.S. citizenship is required to obtain and maintain a government security clearance. Candidates with an active U.S. security clearance are preferred.

Location

Washington, DC; Santa Monica, CA; Pittsburgh PA

Writing Sample Required

Successful applications will include documentation in the application package of academic and professional activities that meet stated qualifications. A writing sample is required for this position. This sample can use a recent, previously written paper or report (e.g., journal article, master’s thesis, or paper written for coursework, prior employment, or internship). Applicants with fields of study or work experience in which they have not produced written products (e.g., model development), or in which written products have dissemination restrictions, may submit a short written summary (i.e., less than one page) of one or more recent products they have developed. Applicants are encouraged to describe their specific role, the analytic or modeling methods used, and the product’s purpose or impact, as appropriate

rows.title: Litigation Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText: Keller Postman delivers justice at scale. We represent individuals and small businesses—hundreds of thousands of them—and get them compensation for harm caused by powerful corporations or the government. We have recovered billions of dollars in litigation against some of the most sophisticated actors in the world. Our work combines the intellectual rigor of legal practice with the innovation, pace, and scale of a tech startup. Our firm accordingly comprises not only world-class lawyers but also distinctive developers, data scientists, designers, communications professionals, and analysts.The Litigation Operations ("LitOps") team sits at the heart of Keller Postman’s intense and interdisciplinary work. Composed of former consultants, lawyers, and product managers, the team is the nexus between the firm’s litigators, technologists, and operations professionals. We are responsible for understanding complex legal situations, translating them into concrete projects, and marshalling resources from across the firm to deliver them. By way of example, LitOps has developed tech products used by hundreds of thousands of clients, put innovative communication tools at the fingertips of our case management team, and built AI-enabled apps to turbocharge record-review and other key legal processes. When Keller Postman delivers justice at scale, the LitOps team contributes the “scale” part.Role: The LitOps team is seeking an analytical, intellectually curious, conscientious, flexible, hardworking, collaborative, and self-motivated individual to report directly to the Chief Counsel for Litigation Operations, the leader of the LitOps function. Working across the firm’s functions, the LitOps Analyst will support and perform complex quantitative and qualitative analysis; assist in developing, building, and maintaining dashboards and other reporting; contribute to product development; coordinate large-scale communications campaigns, and more—all in the high-stakes, fast-paced environment of mass litigation. This position is in-office in our Washington, D.C., office. Compensation for this position, depending on experience, is an annual salary of $95,000 to $115,000 per year, plus benefits and a discretionary bonus. Essential Functions:Support the Chief Counsel for Litigation Operations, Directors of Litigation operations, and LitOps Senior Analysts on mission-critical initiatives requiring detailed analysis and problem solving.Understand, analyze, and report on large, dispersed data sets.Coordinate with LitOps colleagues, attorneys, and operations professionals in the planning, executing, and tracking client-outreach, records-collection, evidence-review, and other workstreams in support of Keller Postman’s litigation campaigns.Assist with external vendors hired to execute client-communication and other tasks.Support the design of client-facing apps, forms, and communications.Master firm technology tools (including Salesforce, Twilio, Monday.com, Azure DevOps, and proprietary tools); identify improvement opportunities and new use cases.Other duties as assigned.Required Skills and Abilities:A structured, analytical, and curious intellect with quantitative instincts and an understanding of basic statistical concepts.Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.Excellent oral and written communication skills.Strong time-management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.Comfort and experience working in a fast-paced, demanding environment.Comfort working both independently and as part of a team.Proficiency (which is more than familiarity) with Microsoft Excel.Experience with SQL or related query languages and platforms preferred.Education/Experience:Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university.1 year of experience at a top-tier consulting firm is preferred.2+ years of experience in an analytical role. rows.title: Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer perception & culture. The Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time social media insights.

Additionally, the Senior Analyst will be a crucial member of the emerging cross-functional capability of AI Readiness by supporting LLM Listening & Visibility analysis, including tool implementation & governance, stakeholder support and incorporation into Social Intelligence analysis deliverables.

After supporting the final stages of the Social Intelligence capability’s implementation across Nestle USA, and the incorporation of LLM Listening into our processes, the Digital & Social Intelligence Senior Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to provide consistent, timely & actionable insights for our brands, while forging a continuous stakeholder feedback loop on our offerings. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Senior Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to balance supporting stakeholders by fulfilling research requests using our best-in-class technology stack, while also training the stakeholders to be able to leverage the technology to find insights on their own. This balance will allow the Senior Analyst, along with the rest of the Digital & Social Intelligence team, to focus our efforts on the most important in-depth analysis the organization needs, while empowering our stakeholders to conduct their own light monitoring of day-to-day digital & social insights questions. The role will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Shopper Insights and Innovation, to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams.

The Senior Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Senior Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of social media and AI-driven technology changes rapidly. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Social Listening, LLM Listening & Related Social Media Research, including Presentation to Stakeholders. Leverage Nestle USA’s Digital & Social Intelligence technology stack to conduct in-depth research about our brands, competitors, product categories and relevant cultural trends, using the insights to deliver a persuasive & visual story to stakeholders that drives action within their key initiatives. This includes navigating technology that handles every facet of Digital & Social Intelligence, such as social listening, ratings & reviews listening, LLM Listening / GEO / AEO, emerging trend identification, social audience persona building, influencer evaluation and owned content performance benchmarking. Where applicable, this also includes combining findings with other data sources outside of Social Intelligence, often via collaboration with our broader Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics and Consumer Insights teams, to provide comprehensive analysis to the stakeholder. Stakeholder Training & Guidance. Assist in the development and execution of training programs, including building training material, leading office hours and sitting one-on-one with stakeholders to guide them through use cases for social listening & social intelligence that build confidence in their ability to navigate the technology to find insights.Stakeholder Request Management. Assist the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager in managing an analysis request queue, which assigns priority to each ad-hoc social research request based on impact to the business, level of effort and urgency. This includes keeping track of stakeholder check-in cadences to ensure the Digital & Social Intelligence team is consistently engaging each key stakeholder group. Tool Output Scanning & Insights Identification. Review the automated reporting outputs from the various tools, including weekly/bi-weekly/monthly AI-driven reports and real-time email alerts, to ensure continuous improvement in the quality of the automated outputs while also mining for actionable insights that need to be flagged to our stakeholders for further discussion & potential action.Tool Maintenance & Governance. Assist in the day-to-day management of the tools, from user access to dashboard/report quality, flagging issues or needs to the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager while collaborating with 3rd party and shared service support teams. Vendor Collaboration. Partnering with analysts from 3rd parties and shared service teams on key research projects and key feature advancements, as well as brainstorming and providing feedback to tool providers on ideal features and functionality that maximize actionability. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field3-5 years of experience in social listening and additional social research, including in-tool navigational experience and strategic storytelling of analysis results.3-5 years in a strategic role working with data analytics, with a focus on developing strong dashboards and/or other automatically refreshable visualizations that empower stakeholders to quickly identify key takeaways from data
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience using Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similar tools throughout every part of the process: query building, dashboard visualization, automated report building and ultimately in-depth analysis of key takeawaysFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening & Visibility / GEO / AEO analysis space, including tools such as ProfoundStrong understanding of how AI can be used to support Digital & Social Intelligence workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsStrong research experience and familiarity with the process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsStrong storytelling experience through the creation and presentation of compelling slide decksAbility to translate business needs into strategic social intelligence frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shiftsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsStrong communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to execute multiple projects at once across various stakeholder teams throughout a large organization
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsFamiliarity with Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for website analyticsFamiliarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesFamiliarity with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets 
Salary: $100,000.00 to $120,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. rows.title: AI Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Gallatin

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

About The Role

We’re looking for an AI/ML Software Engineer to play a foundational role in building and deploying AI-powered solutions for our core product. You’ll work across the full AI/ML lifecycle, from defining and building models to evaluating and deploying large-scale ML pipelines and real-time inference systems, while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful, real-world AI applications.

What You'll Do

Build and Deploy AI/ML ModelsOwn and develop an AI model aligned with our core product needs within your first three months. Validate AI-driven product features through real-world testing and feedback from warfighters. Establish scalable MLOps pipelines and real-time inference services to streamline model training, deployment, runtime, and monitoring. Own high model reliability and uptime by implementing monitoring across your work. Data Collection & ProcessingIdentify and integrate structured, unstructured, batch, and real-time data sources. Work with internal logs, APIs, user interactions, and third-party datasets to improve training data quality. Continuous Improvement & Best PracticesStay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies to improve model performance. Document and share AI/ML development best practices. Contribute to the hiring and mentoring of AI/ML talent as we grow our team. Help the wider team understand the latest trends and the significance of novel approaches in AI. 
What We’re Looking For

Strong Programming SkillsExpertise in at least one: Python, C++, or C. ML Framework ProficiencyHands-on experience with AI/ML training and fine-tuning frameworks, including:PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA, Jupyter NotebooksLarge Language Models (LLMs) and Open-Source Models (Llama, Anthropic, Mistral)LangChain, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Hugging Face, Exo LabsMLOps & Data Engineering KnowledgeExperience with data processing and pipeline frameworks such as Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, AWS Kinesis, pandas, and dbt. Understanding of AI model performance monitoring, data drift detection, and observability tools like Grafana or Kibana. AI Fundamentals & Security AwarenessDeep understanding of deep neural networks (DNNs), LLMs, over/underfitting, prompt engineering, and LLM security (jailbreaking risks and protections). Growth MindsetA passion for continuous learning, staying current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, and teaching others
Bonus Points

Experience mentoring and upskilling junior engineers. Familiarity with legacy systems and working with public sector customers. Contributions to open-source (AI/ML) projects. 

Mission and Identity

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

Why Gallatin?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

Note: Due to the nature of certain government contracts held by this organization, U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin. Proof of citizenship will be required prior to employment if selected.

Compensation Range: $80K - $210K

rows.title: AI/ML Engineer (Full Stack) — Emerging Technologies Practice
rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

CGI is actively seeking an AI/ML and Emerging Tech Expert to join our Emerging Technologies Practice and lead the design and delivery of AI driven applications across our Federal Portfolio. You will work end to end—from proofs of concept to production—partnering with solution architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to turn ideas into scalable, secure solutions. This role blends full stack engineering with modern AI/ML, integrating generative AI and advanced analytics within Azure, AWS, and GCP to achieve tangible business outcomes. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives in fast moving, highly collaborative environments, come help us push the boundaries of AI and emerging technologies.

***This position is located in our Fairfax, VA or Lafayette, LA office; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable***

Your future duties and responsibilities

 AI/ML Solutioning & Delivery Design, build, and deploy AI/ML solutions and generative AI applications; architect complex AI pipelines. Harness large datasets; conduct data mining/analysis; design algorithms and simulations; optimize models for real world performance and cost. Full Stack Engineering Implement front end (HTML/CSS/JavaScript; React or Angular) and back end services (Python/Flask/Django; Node.js; Java) that integrate AI capabilities. Develop robust APIs and microservices; ensure seamless functionality and exceptional UX across platforms. Cloud & DevSecOps Deliver against strategic roadmaps for AI and Analytics architectures across Azure, AWS, GCP. Package and deploy via containerization (Docker, Kubernetes); automate CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab) and IaC (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation). Establish best practices and patterns for AI & analytics; implement monitoring, observability, and model governance. Graph Database Development Design, implement, and optimize GraphDB solutions (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) for AI driven applications. Integrate graph based data models into AI pipelines for knowledge graphs, entity relationships, and semantic search. Collaboration & Client Engagement Work closely with data scientists and software engineers to integrate AI into enterprise systems. Coordinate with client and engineering teams to build, monitor, and maintain solutions. Support client development opportunities and contribute to thought leadership and demos/POCs.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Education

 Bachelor's (required) or Master's (preferred) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, related field.

Experience

 2+ years designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML or advanced software solutions. Proven experience designing and integrating AI/GenAI into products and enterprise applications. Demonstrated success delivering full stack solutions that embed AI capabilities. Hands on experience with GraphDB engineering and development (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar).

Technical Skills

 Programming: Python (expert) plus Java ML/Deep Learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch; model training, tuning, serving, and monitoring. Generative AI: hands on with LLMs; prompt engineering; fine tuning; RAG patterns; vector databases. Web & APIs: HTML/CSS/JS; React or Angular; Node.js/Python/Java back ends; REST/GraphQL. DevOps/MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation; CI/CD with Jenkins/GitLab/Bitbucket; testing frameworks; package managers. Cloud: Production experience on Azure, AWS, and GCP. Data: SQL and NoSQL databases; GraphDB; data pipelines; feature stores.

Professional

 Excellent problem solving, verbal and written communication. Ability to work independently and within agile teams. Strong collaboration skills across cross functional stakeholders.

Desired qualifications/non essential skills required:

 Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in AI/ML or related field. Certifications in Azure/AWS/GCP; Kubernetes, Terraform, or ML specific certifications are a plus. Deep proficiency in Generative AI, including RAG, LLM orchestration frameworks, and model lifecycle governance. Portfolio of successful AI projects; evidence of thought leadership (POCs, publications, OSS contributions). Familiarity with federal sector standards (e.g., secure SDLC, data governance, compliance frameworks) and industry AI use cases. Strong client facing skills: solution storytelling, demos, and executive level presentations.

This role supports organizational transformation by solving complex business challenges through intelligent automation, agent orchestration, and advanced analytics. You must be adaptable, collaborative, and eager to learn new technologies to address multifaceted business problems.

What You Bring To The Role

rows.title: AI Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Gallatin

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

About The Role

We’re looking for an AI/ML Software Engineer to play a foundational role in building and deploying AI-powered solutions for our core product. You’ll work across the full AI/ML lifecycle, from defining and building models to evaluating and deploying large-scale ML pipelines and real-time inference systems, while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful, real-world AI applications.

What You'll Do

Build and Deploy AI/ML ModelsOwn and develop an AI model aligned with our core product needs within your first three months. Validate AI-driven product features through real-world testing and feedback from warfighters. Establish scalable MLOps pipelines and real-time inference services to streamline model training, deployment, runtime, and monitoring. Own high model reliability and uptime by implementing monitoring across your work. Data Collection & ProcessingIdentify and integrate structured, unstructured, batch, and real-time data sources. Work with internal logs, APIs, user interactions, and third-party datasets to improve training data quality. Continuous Improvement & Best PracticesStay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies to improve model performance. Document and share AI/ML development best practices. Contribute to the hiring and mentoring of AI/ML talent as we grow our team. Help the wider team understand the latest trends and the significance of novel approaches in AI. 
What We’re Looking For

Strong Programming SkillsExpertise in at least one: Python, C++, or C. ML Framework ProficiencyHands-on experience with AI/ML training and fine-tuning frameworks, including:PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA, Jupyter NotebooksLarge Language Models (LLMs) and Open-Source Models (Llama, Anthropic, Mistral)LangChain, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Hugging Face, Exo LabsMLOps & Data Engineering KnowledgeExperience with data processing and pipeline frameworks such as Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, AWS Kinesis, pandas, and dbt. Understanding of AI model performance monitoring, data drift detection, and observability tools like Grafana or Kibana. AI Fundamentals & Security AwarenessDeep understanding of deep neural networks (DNNs), LLMs, over/underfitting, prompt engineering, and LLM security (jailbreaking risks and protections). Growth MindsetA passion for continuous learning, staying current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, and teaching others
Bonus Points

Experience mentoring and upskilling junior engineers. Familiarity with legacy systems and working with public sector customers. Contributions to open-source (AI/ML) projects. 

Mission and Identity

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

Why Gallatin?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

Note: Due to the nature of certain government contracts held by this organization, U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin. Proof of citizenship will be required prior to employment if selected.

Compensation Range: $80K - $210K

rows.title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Credit Card Innovation
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

Join the creditflow team, the engine powering our next-generation credit decisioning and valuations model scoring platform. Our mission is to seamlessly connect complex financial data with real-time analytics to optimize credit polity, enhance cash flow underwriting, and deliver lightning-fast credit decisions via valuations model and various analytical capabilities.

As a Senior Data Scientist on the team, you will build a robust scoring platform and deploy models, create innovative analytical tools, leverage alternative data sources, and collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and product to scale our products, valuations models and analytical capabilities. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where your expertise in data, engineering, business and credit knowledge along with machine learning and statistical modeling—powered by a tech stack featuring Python, Snowflake, Conda—will directly impact our credit infrastructure and empower our customers with fairer, more accessible credit products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. rows.descriptionText:
Organization

U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)

Reference Code

FDA-CDRH-2026-0032

How To Apply

Connect with ORISE...on the GO! Download the new ORISE GO mobile app in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store to help you stay engaged, connected, and informed during your ORISE experience and beyond!

A Complete Application Consists Of

An applicationTranscripts – Click here for detailed information about acceptable transcriptsA current resume/CV, including academic history, employment history, relevant experiences, and publication listOne educational or professional recommendation. Your application will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed until one recommendation is submitted.

All documents must be in English or include an official English translation.

If you have questions, send an email to ORISE.FDA.CDRH@orau.org. Please include the reference code for this opportunity in your email.

Application Deadline

12/11/2026 3:00:00 PM Eastern Time Zone

Description

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling-basis.

FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available within the Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), located at Silver Spring, Maryland.

The mission of CDRH is to protect and promote public health. CDRH assures that patients and providers have timely and continued access to safe, effective, and high-quality medical devices and safe radiation-emitting products. CDRH provides consumers, patients, caregivers, and providers with understandable and accessible science-based information about products. CDRH facilitates medical device innovation by advancing regulatory science, providing industry with predictable, consistent, transparent, and efficient regulatory pathways, and assuring consumer confidence in devices marketed in the U.S.

Research Project: An educational research opportunity is available in the Chemical Characterization program in the FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH), Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL).

Silicone and Difficult Materials Project: This project will offer the opportunity to refine and streamline approaches to the extraction and measurement of chemicals from materials of construction that often pose exceptional difficulties during the characterization process. The data-driven methods will be developed through analysis and modeling of existing data, designing experiments, filling any deficiencies in available data, operating chromatography and mass spectrometry equipment, and participating in writing scientific articles.

Learning Objectives: Under the guidance of a mentor, you will gain experience in extractables and leachables analysis in a real-world setting as well as an understanding of regulatory science and medical device chemical characterization review processes.

Mentor: The mentor for this opportunity is Jacob Hill (jacob.hill@fda.hhs.gov). If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentor.

Anticipated Appointment Start Date: June 30, 2027. Start date is flexible and will depend on a variety of factors.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Level of Participation: The appointment is full time.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Citizenship Requirements: This opportunity is available to U.S. citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents (LPR) only.

This program, administered by ORAU through its contract with the U.S. Department of Energy to manage the Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education, was established through an interagency agreement between DOE and FDA. The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience. Proof of health insurance is required for participation in this program. Participants do not become employees of FDA, DOE or the program administrator, and there are no employment-related benefits.

Completion of a successful background investigation by the Office of Personnel Management is required for an applicant to be on-boarded at FDA. OPM can complete a background investigation only for individuals, including non-US Citizens, who have resided in the US for a total of three of the past five years.

FDA Ethics Requirements

If an ORISE Fellow, to include their spouse and minor children, reports what is identified as a Significantly Regulated Organization (SRO) or prohibited investment fund financial interest in any amount, or a relationship with an SRO, except for spousal employment with an SRO, and the individual will not voluntarily divest the financial interest or terminate the relationship, then the individual is not placed at FDA. For additional requirements, see FDA Ethics for Nonemployee Scientists.

Education

FDA requires ORISE participants to read and sign their FDA Education and Training Agreement within 30 days of his/her start date, setting forth the conditions and expectations for his/her educational appointment at the agency. This agreement covers such topics as the following:

Non-employee nature of the ORISE appointment;Prohibition on ORISE Fellows performing inherently governmental functions;Obligation of ORISE Fellows to convey all necessary rights to the FDA regarding intellectual property conceived or first reduced to practice during their fellowship;The fact that research materials and laboratory notebooks are the property of the FDA;

ORISE fellow’s obligation to protect and not to further disclose or use non-public information.

Qualifications

The qualified candidate should have received a doctoral degree in one of the relevant fields. Degree must have been received within the past five years, or anticipated to be received by December 31, 2026.

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with analytical methods such as chromatography and mass spectrometryExperience with LC-MS and GC-MS method development, optimization, and troubleshooting

Point of Contact

 Richard 

Eligibility Requirements">6 )

Citizenship: LPR or U.S. Citizen Degree: Doctoral Degree received within the last 60 months or anticipated to be received by 12/31/2026 11:59:00 PM.  Discipline(s): Chemistry and Materials Sciences (<a href="#" data-bs-toggle="popover" tabindex="0" role="button" data-bs-title="Chemistry and Materials Sciences" data-bs-content="Analytical ChemistryChemistry (General)Materials SciencesOrganic ChemistryPhysical ChemistryPolymer ChemistryComputer, Information, and Data Sciences (1 )

Engineering (3 )

Life Health and Medical Sciences (1 ) 

Affirmation

I have lived in the United States for at least 36 out of the past 60 months. (36 months do not have to be consecutive.)

and

I have read the FDA Ethics Requirements.

rows.title: Post- Doctoral Associate
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description Summary

Organization's Summary Statement:

IBBR is a joint research enterprise of the University of Maryland, College Park, the University of Maryland, Baltimore, and the National Institute of Standards and Technology. IBBR leverages state-of-art integrative methods for bioanalytical, biophysical and structural characterization of biomolecules: cryo-electron microscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance, x-ray crystallography, small angle neutron and x-ray scattering and mass spectrometry. IBBR researchers seek to advance therapeutic development, biomanufacturing, and state-of-the-art measurement technologies, to support accelerated delivery of safe and effective medicines to the public. IBBR is a major initiative and supported in part by the University of Maryland Strategic Partnership: MPowering the State (MPower), an initiative designed to achieve innovation and impact through collaboration.

Job Description Summary:

The Post-Doctoral Associate will work on developing advanced multifunctional polymers for cutting edge life sciences and high-tech engineering applications. This involves synthesis and characterization of hybrid organic-inorganic macromolecules for use in self-assembling nano-scale systems and stimuli responsive materials. The resultant polymer structures and biomaterials are typically characterized by advanced suite of analytical techniques, such as NMR, SEC, AF4, DLS, MALS, ITC and, in some cases, may be directly visualized by cryogenic electron microscopy. The successful applicant will conduct research in a collaborative environment of large industry and NIH funded projects in a multidisciplinary laboratory team.

Minimum Qualifications:

Ph.D. in polymer sciences, chemical engineering or related field.

Hands-on experience in the synthesis, purification, and characterization of synthetic polymers,

Must possess strong interpersonal skills and the ability to contribute in a multidisciplinary team setting.

Excellent oral and written communication skills required, as is the ability to follow safety procedures and maintain a safe work environment.

Physical Demands:

Able to perform conventional research tasks in the synthetic laboratory.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Join an elite Applied AI team within AI Foundations, operating at the intersection of deep research and massive real-world impact. We are pioneering the next generation of personalized customer experiences across Capital One's web and mobile applications, leveraging our high-scale ML models. Our core mission involves architecting and deploying cutting-edge personalized recommendation engines. This is powered by original research into homegrown Foundation Models, advanced Reinforcement Learning techniques, and a state-of-the-art scalable architecture built for billions of interactions. Our research agenda is at the forefront of the field, actively focusing on areas such as Causal Inference, Transformer-based architectures, and sophisticated Recommender Systems.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies - Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more - to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Technical. rows.title: AI Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Gallatin

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

About The Role

We’re looking for an AI/ML Software Engineer to play a foundational role in building and deploying AI-powered solutions for our core product. You’ll work across the full AI/ML lifecycle, from defining and building models to evaluating and deploying large-scale ML pipelines and real-time inference systems, while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful, real-world AI applications.

What You'll Do

Build and Deploy AI/ML ModelsOwn and develop an AI model aligned with our core product needs within your first three months. Validate AI-driven product features through real-world testing and feedback from warfighters. Establish scalable MLOps pipelines and real-time inference services to streamline model training, deployment, runtime, and monitoring. Own high model reliability and uptime by implementing monitoring across your work. Data Collection & ProcessingIdentify and integrate structured, unstructured, batch, and real-time data sources. Work with internal logs, APIs, user interactions, and third-party datasets to improve training data quality. Continuous Improvement & Best PracticesStay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies to improve model performance. Document and share AI/ML development best practices. Contribute to the hiring and mentoring of AI/ML talent as we grow our team. Help the wider team understand the latest trends and the significance of novel approaches in AI. 
What We’re Looking For

Strong Programming SkillsExpertise in at least one: Python, C++, or C. ML Framework ProficiencyHands-on experience with AI/ML training and fine-tuning frameworks, including:PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA, Jupyter NotebooksLarge Language Models (LLMs) and Open-Source Models (Llama, Anthropic, Mistral)LangChain, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Hugging Face, Exo LabsMLOps & Data Engineering KnowledgeExperience with data processing and pipeline frameworks such as Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, AWS Kinesis, pandas, and dbt. Understanding of AI model performance monitoring, data drift detection, and observability tools like Grafana or Kibana. AI Fundamentals & Security AwarenessDeep understanding of deep neural networks (DNNs), LLMs, over/underfitting, prompt engineering, and LLM security (jailbreaking risks and protections). Growth MindsetA passion for continuous learning, staying current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, and teaching others
Bonus Points

Experience mentoring and upskilling junior engineers. Familiarity with legacy systems and working with public sector customers. Contributions to open-source (AI/ML) projects. 

Mission and Identity

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

Why Gallatin?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

Description

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling-basis.

FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available at the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) Office of Rare Diseases, Pediatrics, Urologic and Reproductive Medicine (ORPURM), in the Division of Pediatrics and Maternal Health (DPMH) located in Silver Spring, Maryland. The participation is hybrid with some in-person at the FDA White Oak Campus in Silver Spring, Maryland.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: Pediatric extrapolation relies on the use of inferences about efficacy in children often based on data in adults based on assumptions or evidence of similarity in disease, drug pharmacology and treatment response between adults and children. The need to systematically assess the assumptions underlying extrapolation is well recognized in pediatric drug development. The FDA has access to data from approximately 1,200 pediatric clinical trials, including data from 600 trials spanning more than 300 pediatric development programs, which enables a systematic, disease-focused review. The proposed project aims to analyze adult and pediatric clinical trial data to evaluate the assumptions underlying the extrapolation of pharmacokinetics (PK), efficacy, and safety for selected diseases/conditions.

Educational and Training Components: You will participate in activities related to the research project, including data collection from public and proprietary sources, data analysis and interpretation, and preparation and presentation of research findings for scientific dissemination and publication.

Learning Objectives: Under the guidance of the mentor(s), you will be involved in a systematic review of adult and pediatric clinical trial data, assess similarities of disease between adults and children; understand expected treatment response differences in children, if any; you will assess possibility of leveraging information from previous studies (adult and pediatric) and provide a framework for optimizing trials.

Mentor: The mentor for this opportunity is Lily (Yeruk) Mulugeta (yeruk.mulugeta@fda.hhs.gov). If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentor.

Anticipated Appointment Start Date: January 2027. Start date is flexible and will depend on a variety of factors.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Level of Participation: The participation is hybrid with some in-person at the FDA White Oak Campus in Silver Spring, Maryland.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Citizenship Requirements: This opportunity is available to U.S. citizens and Lawful Permanent Residents (LPR) only.

This program, administered by ORAU through its contract with the U.S. Department of Energy to manage the Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education, was established through an interagency agreement between DOE and FDA. The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience. Proof of health insurance is required for participation in this program. Participants do not become employees of FDA, DOE or the program administrator, and there are no employment-related benefits.

OPM can complete a background investigation only for individuals, including non-US Citizens, who have resided in the US for a total of three of the past five years.

As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Team Description

Join the creditflow team, the engine powering our next-generation credit decisioning and valuations model scoring platform. Our mission is to seamlessly connect complex financial data with real-time analytics to optimize credit polity, enhance cash flow underwriting, and deliver lightning-fast credit decisions via valuations model and various analytical capabilities.

As a Senior Data Scientist on the team, you will build a robust scoring platform and deploy models, create innovative analytical tools, leverage alternative data sources, and collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and product to scale our products, valuations models and analytical capabilities. At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

The Market Intelligence and Research team

MITRE is seeking a curious and collaborative early career Research Analyst, Research Associate, Information Professional, or Librarian to join our Research Services team, a part of MITRE’s Market Intelligence & Research organization. This individual will be responsible for providing, locating, gathering, and analyzing information from third-parties, open-source news and articles, published research papers, subscription and public databases and other sources in support of MITRE’s work programs, and specific sponsor and MITRE initiatives.

As a research associate, this key team member will need a growing understanding and/or interest in databases, digital research libraries, query techniques and short cuts, research and information management practices, and OS intelligence platforms (news alerts, dashboards). This role focuses on desk research, secondary research, literature searching/review, open-source and subscription-based research, and synthesis of existing information for internal clients. This is not a primary research, laboratory, engineering, scientific, or product research role.

This role will translate internal client questions into tangible research objectives to meet the needs of our customers and will engage with internal clients to scope and prioritize tasks, collecting and working with a variety of research outputs, and performing additional desk and secondary research as necessary. This position supports other department capabilities in business analyses, strategy, and sponsor and market intelligence as needed. This role will interact with all levels of the company, including senior level managers, technical SMEs, and analysts.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, highly motivated to find answers, and eager to develop a consultative approach to research support by helping clients refine questions, identify the most relevant sources, and shape actionable outputs. Description

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling-basis.

FDA Office and Location: A research opportunity is available within the Office of Translational Sciences (OTS) Office of Clinical Pharmacology (OCP) Division of Applied Regulatory Science (DARS) at the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) located in Silver Spring, Maryland.

The Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER) performs an essential public health task by making sure that safe and effective drugs are available to improve the health of people in the United States. As part of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), CDER regulates over-the-counter and prescription drugs, including biological therapeutics and generic drugs. These efforts cover more than just medicines.

Research Project: The Food and Drug Administration is seeking a fellow for a Bioinformatics/Biostatistics research project in the Division of Applied Regulatory Science (DARS) located in the Office of Clinical Pharmacology (OCP), Office of Translational Sciences (OTS), Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER). DARS seeks to move new science into the regulatory review process and close the gap between scientific innovation and medical product review.

Biomarker research has been revolutionized by the availability of technologies for assaying biological activity on a global basis by measuring features of the genome, transcriptome, and proteome (so-called "omics"). Large-scale proteomics data has the potential to identify clinically meaningful biomarkers for predicting disease progression, monitoring treatment efficacy, and stratifying patients in clinical trials. DARS is actively evaluating innovative omics technologies and analytical approaches to develop biomarkers that can serve as qualified regulatory tools, supporting standardized endpoints for drug development and informed regulatory decision-making.

This fellowship represents an excellent learning opportunity to research in a visible program area with the potential to substantively advance omics-based biomarker discovery and drug development. You will be directly involved in the statistical analysis of large-scale omics data to inform biomarker discovery for disease expression and severity and to support the development of biomarkers relevant to disease progression and therapeutic response.

You will contribute to the study design and statistical analysis of large-scale omics data generated from biospecimens from clinical trials or well-characterized cohorts. The fellowship will utilize differential expression analysis, systems-level analysis to identify molecular composites and organ-specific signatures, and correlation analyses between molecular markers and disease severity or treatment response. This will include quality control of omics data, statistical modeling, multivariate analysis, pathway and network analysis, data visualization, literature review, and manuscript preparation.

Learning Objectives

Learn to perform quality control and preprocessing of large-scale datasets relevant to regulatory biomarker development.Learn to design and conduct statistical analyses supporting biomarker discovery, including differential expression analysis, effect size estimation, and correction for multiple comparisons.Learn to apply advanced statistical and machine learning methods for identifying multi-protein biomarker panels and assess their correlation with clinical outcomes.Learn to conduct systems-level analyses to identify protein composites, organ-specific signatures, and potential pathways or networks associated with disease phenotypes or drug response.Learn to analyze and interpret omics data within the regulatory science framework to inform drug development and regulatory review.Learn to conduct literature reviews and prepare scientific manuscripts supporting regulatory research dissemination and potential biomarker qualification.

Mentor: The mentor for this opportunity is Paula Hyland (Paula.Hyland@fda.hhs.gov). If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentor.

Anticipated Appointment Start Date: Start date is flexible and will depend on a variety of factors.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Level of Participation: The appointment is full time.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Citizenship Requirements: This opportunity is available to U.S. citizens, Lawful Permanent Residents (LPR), and foreign nationals. Non-U.S. citizen applicants should refer to the Guidelines for Non-U.S. Citizens Details page of the program website for information about the valid immigration statuses that are acceptable for program participation.

This program, administered by ORAU through its contract with the U.S. Department of Energy to manage the Oak Ridge Institute for Science and Education, was established through an interagency agreement between DOE and FDA. The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience. Proof of health insurance is required for participation in this program. Participants do not become employees of FDA, DOE or the program administrator, and there are no employment-related benefits.

Completion of a successful background investigation by the Office of Personnel Management is required for an applicant to be on-boarded at FDA. OPM can complete a background investigation only for individuals, including non-US Citizens, who have resided in the US for a total of three of the past five years.

Qualifications

The qualified candidate should be currently pursuing or have received a doctoral degree in one of the relevant fields (e.g. molecular biology, cell biology, genetics or genomics, biomedical sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, bioinformatics, biostatistics, or a closely related discipline.).

Preferred Skills

Background in statistical analysis methods including differential expression analysis, multivariate statistics, and correction for multiple comparisons (e.g., Bonferroni, Benjamini-Hochberg, FDR).Experience with analysis of one or more omics data types (e.g., proteomics, genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, or epigenomics) and large-scale biological datasets.Working knowledge of statistical programming languages (R, Python) and data visualization tools.Familiarity with pathway analysis methods.Experience with quality control procedures for high-throughput biological data.Knowledge of data mining approaches for biomarker discovery, with the ability to interpret findings in a biological context.Excellent teamwork, organizational, communication, and time-management skills.Ability to multitask, prioritize efficiently, and work independently as well as part of a collaborative team.
