rows.title: AI Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Gallatin

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

About The Role

We’re looking for an AI/ML Software Engineer to play a foundational role in building and deploying AI-powered solutions for our core product. You’ll work across the full AI/ML lifecycle, from defining and building models to evaluating and deploying large-scale ML pipelines and real-time inference systems, while partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful, real-world AI applications.

What You'll Do

Build and Deploy AI/ML ModelsOwn and develop an AI model aligned with our core product needs within your first three months. Validate AI-driven product features through real-world testing and feedback from warfighters. Establish scalable MLOps pipelines and real-time inference services to streamline model training, deployment, runtime, and monitoring. Own high model reliability and uptime by implementing monitoring across your work. Data Collection & ProcessingIdentify and integrate structured, unstructured, batch, and real-time data sources. Work with internal logs, APIs, user interactions, and third-party datasets to improve training data quality. Continuous Improvement & Best PracticesStay ahead of emerging AI trends and technologies to improve model performance. Document and share AI/ML development best practices. Contribute to the hiring and mentoring of AI/ML talent as we grow our team. Help the wider team understand the latest trends and the significance of novel approaches in AI. 
What We’re Looking For

Strong Programming SkillsExpertise in at least one: Python, C++, or C. ML Framework ProficiencyHands-on experience with AI/ML training and fine-tuning frameworks, including:PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA, Jupyter NotebooksLarge Language Models (LLMs) and Open-Source Models (Llama, Anthropic, Mistral)LangChain, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Hugging Face, Exo LabsMLOps & Data Engineering KnowledgeExperience with data processing and pipeline frameworks such as Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, AWS Kinesis, pandas, and dbt. Understanding of AI model performance monitoring, data drift detection, and observability tools like Grafana or Kibana. AI Fundamentals & Security AwarenessDeep understanding of deep neural networks (DNNs), LLMs, over/underfitting, prompt engineering, and LLM security (jailbreaking risks and protections). Growth MindsetA passion for continuous learning, staying current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, and teaching others
Bonus Points

Experience mentoring and upskilling junior engineers. Familiarity with legacy systems and working with public sector customers. Contributions to open-source (AI/ML) projects. 

Mission and Identity

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

Why Gallatin?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

Note: Due to the nature of certain government contracts held by this organization, U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin. Proof of citizenship will be required prior to employment if selected.

Compensation Range: $80K - $210K

Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

Educational Background

Bachelor’s degree in E-Commerce, Digital Marketing, Analytics, Business, or a related field.

Professional Experience

4–7+ years of experience in digital shelf optimization, e-commerce merchandising, digital analytics, or a related area within a CPG/FMCG environment.Experience analyzing retailer e-commerce performance and coordinating content or site improvements is preferred.

support execution.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, E-Commerce, Commercial Strategy, Data Analytics, or a related field. 

Professional Experience

5–8+ years of experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, channel development, or commercial strategy within an FMCG/CPG environment.Experience working with retail partners, digital merchandising, e-commerce activations, or third-party platforms is preferred.

Technical Skills

Comfort using e-commerce analytics and retailer tools. Ability to use business and shopper insights to develop practical recommendations and coordinate execution across teams.

Role Summary:

As a Sales Executive for Colgate-Palmolive, you will be responsible for leading the commercial strategy and driving growth for assigned accounts across various regions. This exciting role sits within our Sales team and offers the opportunity to directly impact business priorities by managing key distributors and guiding a dedicated sales force. You will use your leadership and strategic expertise to transform daily challenges into innovative business solutions, ensuring the long-term success of our brands in the territory. The single most important objective of this role is to maximize sales performance and ensure perfect execution of the 5Ps across all channels.

Responsibilities:

Lead and develop the commercial strategy for assigned chains and accounts to achieve financial metrics, sales objectives, and market share growth. Manage and strengthen strategic relationships between the company and its customers, serving as the primary point of contact for business development and negotiations. Directly oversee the performance of four distributors and their assigned Sales and Marketing teams to ensure alignment with corporate priorities and operational excellence. Execute frequent trade visits to identify market opportunities, monitor competitor activities, and guarantee accurate 5Ps execution at the point of sale. Drive distribution and coverage objectives within the Wholesale, Small, and Store RE channels to increase brand presence and consumer reach. 

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree completed. At least 2+ years of experience in Sales, Commercial or Trade Marketing positions. Demonstrated experience in a mass consumption (CPG) company with a clear understanding of market dynamics. Proficiency in Google Suite and Excel. Valid driver’s license

Preferred Qualifications:

Strong leadership, negotiation, and commercial skills, including the ability to manage portfolios and investments effectively. Transferable technical skills in data analytics that can be applied to optimize territory performance. Intermediate-advanced English level Proficient in SAP, BI, ITT, and Nielsen systems.

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

rows.title: Senior Ethical Trade Executive – Global Ethical Assurance Audit
rows.descriptionText:
Because you can see how we can be better. Innovate, your way. 

Ethical Trade and Environmental Sustainability at Primark

We're responsible for keeping an eye on Primark’s social and sustainability commitments as part of our Primark Cares strategy. As part of our 130- strong team, you'll collaborate with suppliers, champion ethical practices, and make a tangible difference. All with the purpose of ensuring we meet social compliance, environmental sustainability & legislative requirements, industry initiatives and standards.

What You’ll Get 

The work you do shapes the impact we have. We’re focused on providing you with the culture to reach your potential. Your wellbeing is our top priority.:   

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as a Senior Ethical Trade Executive – Global Ethical Assurance AUDIT

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:  

Own day-to-day analysis, recording, and reporting to ensure compliance with Primark’s Global Social Audit Assurance Programme, working cross-functionally with ETES, Central Support, regional teams, CR Hub, Legal, and People & Culture.Support the implementation of company policies, standards, and reporting requirements for social audits, under the guidance of the Head of Global Audit Assurance (GAA).Define and strengthen governance, accountability, and oversight frameworks for monitoring and maintaining the global social audit programme.Identify audit training and awareness needs, coordinating regional delivery with regional leads and the Head of GAA.Develop KPIs and performance metrics to support programme management, partnering with Central Support and Technology & Systems teams to drive continuous improvement.Lead programme monitoring activities, including quarterly reviews, risk assessments, due diligence checks, and escalation of risks or issues, ensuring procedures remain aligned to regulatory and best-practice standards. 

What You’ll Bring  

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

Minimum 5 years’ experience in an ESG (Social) analytics or social compliance role, with a strong understanding of social audit protocols, benchmarks, and assurance programmes.Proven ability to manage social compliance processes, develop process flows, procedures, and KPIs, and translate data into clear, actionable insights.Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work confidently with peers and mid‑to‑senior stakeholders across functions.High proficiency in MS Office, with experience designing, developing, and presenting clear, business‑focused reports.Demonstrated analytical, research, and problem‑solving capabilities, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work under pressure.A collaborative, personable, and proactive team player, able to build strong relationships, prioritize effectively, and communicate ideas in a clear, user‑friendly way. 

Excited? Good. Because it’s energising to put your skills to work, in a growing global business committed to encouraging people to express themselves – and feel a sense of belonging. Apply to be part of Primark’s future, today… and enjoy career growth, our way.  

About Primark 

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business a over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

The Partner Growth Executive will work with the Ocado Partner Account team to drive the growth agenda in our partner’s business, enabling our partners to improve commercial outcomes, grow their customer base, order volume, and overall profitability.

rows.title: Software Engineer II
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

A Software Engineer II is proficient with the most-often used features of the programming language, its core library, commonly used 3rd party libraries, and commonly used code management and build tooling.

Initially a Software Engineer II is expected to be able to develop a medium set of defined, inter-related modules, articulate why the code and application they are working on are designed the way they are, and be able to provide some instructive feedback to newer developers through code reviews and in-person Q&A. As they progress, they should be able to implement smaller subsystems independently, begin to design small portions of the systems, and begin to understand the design principles and practices that cut across all the applications.

The goals of a Software Engineer II are:

Develop an understanding of why some libraries, frameworks, and tooling are designed the way they are: what tradeoffs were made? why might the developer have done that? Through this work, develop an understanding of the practical use of design patterns. Begin to understand some of the externalities associated with running an application: performance, security, operations, monitoring, etc. Be able to troubleshoot application, infrastructure, and environment issues. 

Or, more succinctly, the Software Engineer II is gaining the ability to determine why things are done in a particular way and apply that knowledge to new situations.

General Responsibilities

Development - 90%

Produces estimates for their assigned tasks given well defined business requirementsProduces quality code that meets internal and industry standardsPromotes reusability within the application they are developingWrites performant code according to industry standards and project/organizational KPIsUnderstands business concepts in their area of focusWrites clear documentation to ensure code is understandable to provide wider focus and understanding into design decisionsProvides input into designs for assigned tasksTranslates designs into code for their assigned tasksUnderstands build/deployment processes and can support moving their code and any other changes (ex: database) through these phases. Creates build/deployment artifacts as neededSupports production systems through troubleshooting/triaging issues and providing on-call support where needed

Mentoring - 10%

Role Overview

We are seeking Principal Engineers to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale.

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered dataVector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e.g., HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviewsCollaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications

Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above rolesModern C++ Expertise: 12+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std::atomic). Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e.g., vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc.)

Bonus Qualifications

Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. Functional domain awareness – CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrencyChallenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. rows.descriptionText:
What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What’s the role?

As a Product Specialist here at Bilt, you will be the dedicated customer advocate for everything we build. This role exists to ensure our products are not only thoughtfully designed and launched, but are continuously maintained and improved through constant feedback loops between our internal teams and end users.

This role sits at the intersection of product operations, product analysis, and quality assurance. The Product Specialist partners closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and Support, as well as other cross-functional teams, to ensure products work as intended, launch smoothly, and improve over time. They are deeply embedded in the product lifecycle and constantly pressure-test flows, track performance, and surface insights that improve the experience.

In this role, you will… 

Act as the customer advocate

Represent end users in pod discussions and decision makingRun full product journeys end to end to understand the real experienceIdentify friction, confusion, and complexity across B2C and B2B experiences

Support product readiness

Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, Support, Legal, and Policy teamsSurface downstream implications for internal teams and customers before and after launchEnsure shared understanding of how products should behave across systems and use cases

Track performance and behavior

Monitor core product and business metrics tied to adoption, usage, and experienceAnalyze user behavior and product performance to identify trends, gaps, and opportunitiesTranslate learnings from testing and experimentation into clear recommendations

Identify improvement opportunities

Identify key problem areas, edge cases, and failure pointsSpot issues impacting specific customer segments, partners, or workflowsSurface insights from data, support signals, and operational feedback

Own quality and testing

Act as first line of defense for product qualityTest new features, enhancements, and integrations across environmentsDocument and prioritize bugs, inconsistencies, and usability issuesPartner with engineering and product to resolve issues quickly

Drive AI usage and adoption

Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude as part of daily workBuild and refine AI workflows to streamline testing, analysis, and documentationAnalyze large volumes of qualitative and quantitative signals using AIIdentify opportunities where AI can improve speed, quality, or clarityPressure test AI-powered features from a user perspective

In Terms Of Qualifications, We’re Seeking

2+ years of experience working in a product role Deeply obsessive about user experience and product qualityNaturally detail-oriented with strong product intuitionComfortable advocating for the customer and pushing for clarityCurious, analytical, and motivated by making things better every dayExperience in product operations, product analytics, QA, consulting, or similar rolesHigh level of comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar platforms in day-to-day workAbility to design and iterate on AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and insight generationStrong analytical skills and comfort working with product and business dataAbility to synthesize quantitative signals and qualitative feedback into actionable insightsExcellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate issues and recommendationsExperience working closely with engineering and design teams (nice to have)Familiarity with analytics tools or SQL (nice to have)Experience supporting both consumer and partner-facing products (nice to have)

Benefits

Compensation - We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus programHealth insurance for you (& your loved ones) from day one - Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.401k plan with a match - Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.Commuter FSAs - We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.UNLIMITED PTO - Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points - We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.Team Events - We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The salary range for a Product Specialist is $70,000 - 120,000 and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance-based bonus.

The VP, Global Benefits partners with the Head of Total Rewards to execute Circana’s global benefits strategy, and is the primary owner of benefits governance, budget, vendor and broker management, regulatory compliance, and operational delivery. This role is accountable for centralizing benefits delivery currently dispersed across regional HR Business Partner teams into a consistent, governed, enterprise capability, in service of Circana’s HR vision of a simple, proactive, and scalable employee experience.

Working closely with Compensation, Total Rewards leadership, HR Technology, Legal, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, HR Business Partners, and business leaders, this role ensures benefits programs are designed and administered consistently, equitably, competitively, and in compliance with local regulatory requirements across all countries in which Circana operates.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership over the global benefits portfolio, builds the governance model, operating model, and data foundation needed for scalable delivery, and leads a growing team of benefits professionals as the function centralizes. This is a unique opportunity to help build and modernize Circana's global benefits capability at a pivotal stage of growth. This role is best suited for a leader who has successfully built, transformed, or centralized benefits capabilities and can quickly establish credibility, influence, and results in a complex global environment.

This is an evolving role, built for how work should be organized in an AI-enabled function. The leader will architect a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, anchored on the organization's most important priorities (determined through our Business Strategy, HR Mission and Vision, and People Strategy), deliberately elevating team members to complex, judgment-driven, and people-centric work while putting automation and AI to work on repetitive, transactional tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Global Benefits Strategy Partnership

Partner with the Head of Total Rewards to shape and execute the global benefits strategy, ensuring programs remain market-competitive, cost-effective, and aligned to Circana’s Total Rewards philosophy and talent priorities. Oversee execution of global benefit design, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns day-to-day design decisions across health & welfare, retirement/pension, wellbeing, and voluntary benefits. Partner with Compensation on the broader Total Rewards Framework to ensure benefits are positioned consistently with pay philosophy and market positioning. 

Transformation & M&A Integration

Oversee harmonization of benefits plan design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring outcomes align to enterprise strategy and budget. Provide executive sponsorship for benefits due diligence and integration planning for future M&A activity, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design on design execution. Approve new-country benefit program design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring alignment to global strategy and budget. 

Governance & Centralization

Build and lead the governance model, standards, decision rights, and operating framework needed to centralize benefits administration currently managed by regional HR Business Partners. Establish and lead the transition plan, timeline, and change management approach for migrating benefits from HRBP teams to a centralized Benefit function. Set the standards for global benefits policies, procedures, and documentation, and govern their consistent application across regions. 

Vendor, Broker & Financial Management

Own broker, carrier, and third-party administrator relationships and contracts globally for material renewals, partnering with Procurement on RFP mechanics and formal vendor process, and using AI-assisted analysis for renewal-package review and first-pass prep. Lead negotiation and final decisions on broker/carrier renewals and RFP outcomes for material renewals, ensuring service quality and cost discipline; routine renewal documentation and coordination is supported by the Benefits Vendor & Systems Coordinator. Own the global benefits budget; monitor spending, forecast costs, and identify efficiency opportunities in partnership with Finance. 

Compliance & Regulatory Governance

Ensure compliance with applicable benefits regulations across all countries of operation, including ERISA, ACA, and country-specific statutory requirements. Partner with Legal and Total Rewards on regulatory readiness for initiatives such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive and country-specific benefits mandates (e.g., India). Maintain audit readiness, required filings, and documentation for all benefits programs. 

Administration, Systems & Data

Ensure end-to-end benefits administration — including enrollment, life events, leave of absence coordination, and escalations — is delivered effectively by the Manager, Benefits – Administration & Delivery, determining outsourcing/co-sourcing opportunities as needed. Partner with HR Technology/EE&T on benefits system configuration, data integrity, and integration with the broader HR technology ecosystem, including the Job Architecture data foundation. Establish benefits reporting and analytics that support decision-making — cost, utilization, and compliance data framed to inform plan renewal, vendor negotiation, and design choices, not just tracked for visibility. Leverage AI and automation to redesign repetitive, transactional benefits processes — enrollment, eligibility, compliance monitoring, and reporting — freeing the team’s capacity for higher-judgment, people-centric work. 

Employee Experience & Communication

Ensure employee sentiment on benefits satisfaction is monitored and incorporated into program design, led by the Director, Benefit Design. Partner with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns the benefits journey map and end-to-end employee experience strategy, ensuring alignment with Circana’s talent strategy and HR Mission and Vision. Provide executive sponsorship for employee communication, education, and enrollment campaigns led by the Director, Benefit Design, in partnership with HR Business Partners and Talent Management. Serve as an escalation point for complex benefits matters, partnering with HR Business Partners during the centralization transition. 

Cross-Functional Partnership & Team Leadership

Partner with Compensation, Talent Management, Payroll, Legal, Finance, and HR Business Partners to ensure benefits programs support broader Total Rewards and talent strategy. Build and evolve a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, structured around the organization’s most important priorities; deliberately allocating complex, people-centric work to team members and repetitive work to automation and AI as capabilities are built. Partner with Procurement on vendor sourcing, contracting, and cost management strategy for benefits vendors, brokers, and carriers. Leverage partners across the HR organization — including HR Business Partners, Talent Management, and HR Technology — to bring broader expertise and reach global benefits initiatives. Represent Global Benefits in Total Rewards leadership discussions and HRLT initiatives as needed. 

Requirements

8+ years of progressive benefits experience, including demonstrated expertise in global benefits design, governance, vendor management, and regulatory compliance. Strong global benefits and regulatory acumen, including deep knowledge of U.S. requirements (ERISA, ACA) and experience navigating multi-country frameworks such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Demonstrated experience leading benefits strategy, administration, or governance across multiple countries and regions is required. Fluency in applying AI and automation to redesign operational and administrative processes, with a track record of shifting team capacity from transactional work toward higher-judgment, strategic, and people-centric priorities. Demonstrated experience building, centralizing, harmonizing, or transforming benefits operations, ideally in a multi-country, multi-entity, or post-merger environment. Proven vendor and broker management skills, including RFPs, contract negotiation, and performance governance. Strong financial acumen, with experience owning and managing a global benefits budget. Experience partnering with HR Technology teams on benefits systems, data integrity, and reporting. Excellent communication, consultation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex benefits concepts for executive and employee audiences. People leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams, including experience designing flexible, virtual, or hybrid team structures that flex with business priorities. Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of strengthening governance, controls, and scalable benefits solutions that support organizational growth. Experience building new capabilities, operating models, governance structures, or shared-service approaches within a benefits or Total Rewards function. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities with experience leveraging technology and reporting to improve outcomes. 

Circana Behaviors

rows.title: Sr Software Engineer, Ads Auctions & Marketplace Optimization
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on? Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the US, Canada and Mexico, with more than 100 million active accounts. Every ad impression across that platform has to be cleared and priced in real time — that is what the Ads Auctions and Marketplace Optimization team does. We build the auction mechanics, the pricing and pacing logic, and the low-latency systems that run them, balancing outcomes for advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku on every request. We are growing the team in Cambridge, which is becoming its largest hub, alongside colleagues in Amsterdam, Austin, San Jose, Ukraine and Uruguay — so you would be shaping how the UK side of this team works rather than inheriting it.What is the role? You will build the systems that apply mathematical and algorithmic rigour to optimise across multiple objectives, deciding which ads get served, in which placements, and when. The work spans auction mechanics, optimisation, the output of predictive ML models, and the real-time infrastructure underneath, mostly in Java on the JVM. It is hands-on and senior in scope: expect to move between whiteboard-level design and production code in the same week, and to own problems from framing through rollout. You will work directly with the hiring manager and a small group of senior engineers, in codebases shared with other ads engineers, on problems where your decisions are visible in revenue. You will optimise for second-order effects in a marketplace where participants react to each other, and to us, in real time. We are looking for people who are enthusiastic about solving these kinds of problems.How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.What are the responsibilities of the role? Design and build components of Roku's real-time ad auction and marketplace systemsOwn the multi-objective optimisation at the core of the auction, balancing what advertisers, publishers, viewers, and Roku each want from the same impressionOwn development work end to end, from framing the problem through production rolloutBuild and operate JVM services where latency and reliability are product requirements, not stretch goalsUse probability, statistics and experimentation to test changes before and after launchWork with AI tooling as a normal part of how you design, build, test and reviewExplain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partnersWhat experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? Around six or more years building production software, with strong systems judgementProduction experience in Java or another JVM language, or depth in a comparable statically typed language such as C#, C++ or Go, and the appetite to ramp on JavaComfort designing and operating distributed systems at scale and low latencyA solid grounding in maths, algorithms, probability and statistics as applied to real systemsDemonstrated AI and agentic-tooling fluency, as described aboveAd tech, auctions or marketplace experience is preferred, and we move quickly for candidates who have itComparable experience on mathematically rigorous or optimisation-heavy problems in another domain is an acceptable alternative What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Why Hearst

Hearst is one of the nation's largest diversified media, information and services companies, with a portfolio of more than 360 businesses worldwide. Our consumer businesses include television stations, newspapers, magazines and ownership stakes in cable networks. Our business-to-business companies include Fitch Group, Hearst Health and Hearst Transportation. Across our businesses, you'll find opportunities to do meaningful work, grow your career and make an impact.

About This Role

Hearst Technology Services is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help shape our data and AI technology roadmap. You'll own the full lifecycle of complex data projects — from analysis and design through development and production support — building pipelines and integrations that move data securely and reliably across cloud platforms. You'll also help design the tooling that extracts, transforms, and governs data from both internal systems and external sources, and act as a technical resource for engineers, analysts, and data scientists across the business.

What You'll Do

 Design and build scalable, secure pipelines that ingest, transform, and move large volumes of structured and unstructured data across systems.  Build APIs and complex database logic to automate the fetch, transformation, and storage of data in multiple formats.  Use generative AI tools to accelerate the development, testing, and maintenance of pipelines across Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and Databricks.  Architect and maintain modular, reusable components that power larger data and AI applications, deployed via containerized workflows (Docker/Kubernetes) where applicable.  Design, build, and maintain data solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.  Implement data quality, security, and governance standards consistently across cloud environments, including integrations between platforms like Informatica IDMC and MDM.  Securely handle PHI, PII, and PCI data in line with regulatory and internal compliance requirements. rows.title: Supply Chain Support Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Supply Chain Support Lead

In this varied and engaging role, you'll support, develop, and deliver supply chain data and tooling solutions that give NatWest Markets (NWM) a competitive advantageYou'll support both colleagues within NWM Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) and individual business owners, enabling accurate and timely delivery of reporting, using data from our internal and external supplier portfolios to provide consistent and dynamic insightsThe work you do will improve the client experience, continually improve our processes, and ensure delivery is aligned with our strategic goals, cost and risk appetite expectations

What You'll Do

As a Supply Chain Support Lead, you'll own and deliver process efficiencies, improve the overall turnaround time, and support the team to deliver continuous improvements. You'll interrogate broad data sets across our internal and external supplier portfolios to draw inferences on benefit opportunities and risk exposure. You'll also generate clear, accurate and timely executive-level reporting to support sourcing and supplier decisions.

As well as managing risks, you'll manage the process maps, standard operating procedures, and other documentation related to all processes. You'll support the team in transitioning manual processes to online tooling, driving efficiencies and enabling more dynamic insights that no longer rely on comparing manual data sources. You'll work in collaboration with other teams to improve data quality, consistency and usability.

As Well As This, You'll

Champion sustainability by supporting our environmental, social, and governance (ESG) approachSupport colleagues within NWM TPRM to develop and maintain online tools, dashboards and reportingKeep iSupply, ServiceNow and other relevant records up to date with accurate informationIdentify opportunities to simplify and automate manual processes, improving efficiency and reducing reliance on comparisons across manual data sourcesDeepen the relationships with TPRM functions across NWG and effectively utilise data and analytics reports to identify benefit opportunities, risk exposure and the overall supplier portfolio performance

The Skills You'll Need

We're looking for someone with supply chain knowledge and strong data analytical and tooling skills, with a demonstrable track record of using broad data sets to generate insight and support implementation. You'll have experience of developing reporting and transitioning manual processes to online tooling, together with an understanding of supply chain models such as offshoring, outsourcing, utility, and make versus buy.

Furthermore, You'll Demonstrate

Experience of applying supply chain and data analytical skills and techniques to impact business strategy and outcomes, supplier selection and supplier managementExperience in developing executive-level reporting and drawing clear conclusions on benefit opportunities and risk exposure across internal and external supplier portfoliosExperience in data management, process standardisation, simplification and transitioning manual processes to online toolingA proven track record in taking ownership for resolving data and tooling issues

rows.title: Events Manager - Corporate and Institutional Banking
rows.descriptionText:
Why HSBC 

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

 The Opportunity 

This role sits in Global Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) Marketing and focuses on planning and delivering assigned global events and sponsorships across in-person, virtual and hybrid formats. It translates the global events strategy into high-quality experiences that support client engagement, brand positioning and business priorities. Working closely with global, regional and local marketing teams, business stakeholders and external agencies you’ll run delivery across the full event lifecycle from briefing and planning through to measurement and follow-up. You’ll also help strengthen the operating model through toolkits, processes, governance and reporting. Success looks like well-executed events that meet commercial objectives, deliver a consistent client journey and generate clear, actionable insights for future improvements.

What You'll Be Doing

 Manage end-to-end delivery of assigned strategic global events and sponsorships from briefing through to post-event evaluation  Shape best-in-class client journeys across invitation, registration, onsite or virtual experience and follow-up  Partner with business and marketing stakeholders to align events to priorities, audiences and agreed objectives  Coordinate agencies, suppliers and strategic partners to ensure quality delivery and value for money  Control event budgets and maintain accurate documentation including decision logs, action trackers, risk registers and post-event records  Apply event toolkits and recommend updates based on delivery experience to improve consistency and efficiency  Prepare materials for the Events Council, consolidate updates, track actions and escalate items requiring decisions  Track event performance including attendance, engagement, feedback and relevant commercial measures then turn insights into recommendations 

What We're Looking For

 Bring proven experience in marketing, event management, client experience or a closely related discipline ideally within banking or financial services  Deliver high-quality events across multiple regions including in-person, virtual and hybrid formats  Apply event marketing practices across audience engagement, registration management, lead generation and measurement  Work within governance, risk, compliance, procurement and brand requirements and apply them to event delivery  Build and maintain practical toolkits, processes and frameworks that support consistent delivery  Manage budgets, monitor costs and negotiate with suppliers while identifying efficiencies  Use event management platforms, digital engagement tools and reporting or analytics solutions to interpret data and improve outcomes  Oversee multiple workstreams and deadlines with clear stakeholder management across global, regional and local teams 

This is an opportunity to deliver event experiences that connect CIB clients to HSBC’s insights, people and priorities at a global scale. The role combines hands-on delivery alongside planning, governance and measurement. If you’ve built strong event programmes that balance creativity with rigour and stakeholder alignment we’d like to hear from you. Join the team and help set a consistently high standard for client experience across our global events portfolio.

 Opening up a world of opportunity. 

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

rows.title: Commercial Analysis Manager
rows.descriptionText:

rows.title: Director of Product, AML & Fraud Prevention
rows.descriptionText:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime.

We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. As a regulated financial institution operating across Europe, our obligations grow as we grow: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing controls, sanctions screening, KYC, transaction monitoring are protecting our members and our balance sheet from fraud and other illegal activities. Today these capabilities sit across several teams and tools. This domain will own them end to end, and turn financial crime prevention into a mature product: controls that satisfy regulators without adding friction for the honest majority.

This is a newly created domain. As its leader you will work with your functional peers (Engineering, Data, Design) to assess the status quo and construct the long-term vision. You will be responsible for setting domain goals, delivering on already identified opportunities, hiring, and executing the product vision.

You’ll report to the leader of Engineering/Product/Design/Analytics at Vinted Pay, and partner with Product Directors across Vinted Pay and the wider marketplace, as well as with our Compliance, Legal, Risk, Risk Operations, Engineering, Design and Analytics functions.

In this position, you’ll 

Drive and align the AML & Fraud Prevention domain on a single, unified vision, expressed through measurable objectives and key resultsOwn the product roadmap across AML/CTF, sanctions and PEP screening, KYC, transaction monitoring and fraud prevention, build alignment across product teams, cross-functional partners and the leadershipPartner with our MLRO, Compliance, Risk and Legal teams to translate regulatory obligations into product requirements and make the case for automated solutions where manual controls are in placeManage multiple competing objectives and provide clarity to the delivering organisation Use and analyse data to size risk, identify product opportunities, and build the right capabilities at the right timeOwn build-vs-buy decisions, then assess and collaborate with the vendors in building and maintaining AML/Fraud prevention solutionsGet ahead of regulatory change: the EU AML package and AMLA, PSD3/PSR, evolving sanctions regimes, rather than reacting to itBuild, mentor, lead and scale a team of Product ManagersImplement best in class product development and managerial practices

About You

7+ years of experience in product management, with a substantial part of it in AML, financial crime, compliance, risk or fraud, ideally at a regulated financial institution, e-money institution, PSP, bank or fintech4+ years of developing people and managing teams, including Product ManagersDeep working knowledge of the AML domain: KYC and identity verification, customer risk scoring, sanctions and PEP screening, transaction monitoring and alert handling, SAR/STR reporting, and the regulatory frameworks behind them (EU AML directives and the AML package, national transpositions, FATF standards)Hands-on experience with fraud and scam prevention: detection models and rules engines, account takeover controls, chargebacks and disputes, and the trade-off between loss reduction and false positivesA proven track record of successful product launches (at least two substantial projects with a 6–9 month minimum duration)Comfortable operating in a regulated environment: you have worked alongside compliance officers, internal and external auditors and supervisors, and you know how to move quickly without creating regulatory exposureAble to deliver from 0 to 1, and not afraid to build your own tools to achieve your goalsExceptional leadership skills and substantial experience building high-performing teams of 10+, ideally not only in product (and we’d expect your former teams to still be singing your praises!)Significantly above-average business acumen, analytical skills and long-term planning skillsBoth quantitative and qualitative: able to assess and understand complex systems quickly, to integrate usability studies, research and market analysis into product requirements, and to be a product ambassador to the rest of the organisationWell organised, with a collaborative attitude and a strong sense of ownershipAn excellent communicator, including in written and spoken English

Work perks 

The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme25 days of paid annual leaveNewest MacBook modelsDigital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)Frequent team-building eventsHome office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furnitureLunch benefit per working dayAccess to a discounted gym membership planA personal monthly budget for shopping on VintedComprehensive Medical InsuranceGroup Life and Income Protection InsuranceA matched pension scheme up to a set limit. The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workationPension plan with the opportunity to choose your contribution percentage, and Vinted will match it up to a set limit

Working at Vinted 

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

£105,800—£143,200 GBP

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

We are looking for a senior leader to own the Data Trust and Governance on Data Infrastructure and Strategy (DI&S) team within Uber's Customer Advocacy Solutions (CAS) organization. This role is critical to ensuring that our customer support data remains reliable, consistent, trusted, and fit for purpose as we scale support operations, modernize the data platform, and expand AI-driven fully self-service.

The person in this role will establish and drive governance standards across data quality, observability, lineage, metadata, metric definitions, semantic clarity, and full data context. They will work closely with engineering, analytics, product, operations, science and AI stakeholders to ensure customer support data is correct, aggregated and explainable for human users, while also being connected, contextual, timely, and grounded for AI systems.

This is a high-impact data leadership role at the intersection of product, engineering and AI. Success in this role requires building trust in data for both traditional governance outcomes and the next generation of agentic AI analytics readiness.

What You Will Do

 Data Quality & Trust: Establish and enforce high data quality and trust standards, making quality the default expectation and measurably proven through data, not assumed.  Analytics & AI Data Foundation: Govern the shared canonical data foundation powering trusted analytics and AI.  Data Observability: Establish observability, freshness, and reliability standards with effective system controls to proactively detect issues and consistently meet defined data contract and SLAs.  Master Data & Semantics: Govern master data, metadata, business definitions, semantics, context and ontology for consistent human and AI consumption.  Metrics & Lineage: Govern metric definitions, lineage, and source traceability so root-cause analysis and drill-down from reported metrics to underlying facts are available by default.  AI Readiness: Establish and enforce analytics- and AI-ready data standards for reliable agentic AI and analytics.  Governance & Adoption: Establish clear ownership, stewardship, accountability, and adoption of governance standards.  Shift-Left Governance: Embed governance, quality, observability, and AI-readiness requirements into data design and modernization. 

Basic Qualifications

 Minimum 5 years of experience in an analytics-focused role with experience in extracting insights from data and summarizing key findings and takeaways  Bachelors Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative fields  Experience establishing and operationalizing at least two of the core data governance functions: data quality, data observability, data lineage or metadata management, master data management and metrics governance at enterprise level. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Masters Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative fields  Experience establishing data governance and trust for AI/ML and agentic AI, including standards for machine-consumable, contextual, grounded, and evaluation data.  Experience with canonical data modeling, event and state modeling, identity resolution, and end-to-end journey data supporting both analytics and AI.  Experience embedding shift-left governance into large-scale data modernization, cloud platforms, source instrumentation, and data engineering practices.  Practical understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval, copilots, and AI-driven workflows, particularly the data foundations required to make them reliable.  Experience applying modern data governance in customer support or similarly complex operational domains, where data connects customer journeys, automation, human workflows, and business outcomes.  Experience working knowledge of metadata, master data, business semantics, metric governance, data lineage, and source traceability.  Experience leading cross-functional data governance programs, establish ownership and accountability, and communicate effectively with technical, business, and executive stakeholders.  Experience establishing and operationalizing data quality, trust, observability, data SLAs, issue management, and governance controls at scale.  Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL with proven ability to write and understand complex queries.
